chapters.title: Chapter 51: Zhong Yan's Acceptance
paragraphs: Zhang Fei asked innocently. "What do you want to talk to me about, Big Sis Yan?"

"Are you in a relationship with any other woman besides Xue, Fei'er?" Zhong Yan seriously asked. Before she made up her mind to dispel the thoughts that had been bothering her since morning, she wanted to know the real Zhang Fei first.
Zhang Fei nodded and answered without hesitation. "Apart from Xue, I have another official woman, and I also have three unofficial women."
The official woman that Zhang Fei was referring to was Liu Hua, and the three unofficial women were Zhang Lin, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing. Whereas Liu Qingyu was someone else's wife.
Zhang Fei also still feels complicated about Qing Yi. Although he is still angry with his mother, she is still the woman who gave birth to him, and he would not exist without her.
As for Hong Yao, Zhang Fei had never thought of her as his woman, and she would always be his servant.
Zhong Yan looked at Zhang Fei with wide eyes in shock. She was really shocked by his confession of being in a relationship with five women. Moreover, he looked so proud of his relationship.

Ru Xue also felt shocked hearing that, even though she already knew that Zhang Fei was an incubus and needed many women, she didn't know that he already had several other women besides her. 'Since when did he have four other women? And why didn't he tell me?'
"Can you tell me the identities of your other four women, Fei'er?" Zhong Yan seriously asked, and Ru Xue also looked at him, waiting for his answer.
Zhang Fei didn't immediately answer Zhong Yan's question, he looked at her and Ru Xue in turns. He then took a deep breath, and said it. "They are Zhang Lin, Liu Hua, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing."

Zhong Yan and Ru Xue were instantly stupefied; the name of the first woman made their brains seem to stop functioning for a moment. Since they knew that she was his little sister, and their feelings became chaotic after hearing that.

Zhang Fei also didn't say any further, and waited for them to come to their senses first. He was aware that his relationship with his little sister was difficult for ordinary people to accept, but he didn't want to lie to them.

They continued to be silent for about ten minutes, and Ru Xue suddenly sighed, she then said. "Even though I feel weird about incestuous relationships with Zhang Lin, but I can't do anything about it either, especially since I already know your true identity."
"What do you mean by his true identity, Xue?" Zhong Yan turned to her and asked.
Ru Xue then looked at Zhang Fei. "Aren't you going to tell her the truth?"
"Tell me what's really going on?" Zhong Yan also urged Zhang Fei, she really wanted to know everything first before making up her mind.
Zhang Fei sighed softly, then transformed himself into his incubus form.
Zhong Yan immediately jumped from her seat when she saw his incubus form, and she hid behind Ru Xue in fear, as she stuttered. "You... are... an incubus... Fei'er?"
"Well, I am indeed an incubus." Zhang Fei nodded at her, then he transformed himself into his half-fox form. "But I'm also a beast fox man."
"Huh!?" Zhong Yan was taken aback by the sight, as was Ru Xue; it was her first time learning that Zhang Fei was also a beast fox man.
They immediately approached Zhang Fei and rubbed his fox ears and tail. Unlike his demon form, which frightened Zhong Yan, she was actually very mesmerized by his half-fox form.
"Wow, your ears are really soft and smooth!" Zhong Yan is full of admiration.
Ru Xue continued, rubbing his tail against her cheek."Your tail is the same, and I really like it."
Zhang Fei was speechless at their antics, but then he remembered that his two sisters also liked soft and fluffy things. He smiled faintly and transformed himself into his little white fox form.
Zhang Fei was right, and their eyes lit up at the sight of his little white fox form, Zhong Yan then carried him in her arms and caressed his soft fur. "Hehe, you are so cute in this form."
"I want to carry him too, Yan!" Ru Xue said, pouting.
Mei laughed at seeing Zhang Fei being fought over by them. [They seem to be crazy about your little white fox form, Master]
'Sigh, I don't know why women like fluffy creatures; even my sisters like them.' Zhang Fei helplessly replied.
[Chu Qing is also the same as them; she also really likes your little white fox form, Master.]
Zhang Fei felt dizzy from constantly shifting in their hands; he then jumped from their hands and returned to his human form.
Seeing that, Zhong Yan and Ru Xue pouted their lips; they still weren't satisfied playing with the little white fox yet.

Zhang Fei shook his head at them, with a wry smile on his face, then he asked Zhong Yan. "So what's your decision? I know that you are interested in me, and you already know my situation, so it's all up to you now."

Zhong Yan did not immediately answer his question and continued to stare at him seriously. Before long, she sighed softly and stood right in front of Zhang Fei, she then cupped his cheeks and kissed him on the lips.
Zhang Fei was relieved by that and hugged Zhong Yan's waist, then he kissed her back, and they kissed for some time.
Seeing them like that, Ru Xue smiled happily, and she felt very happy that her best friend was finally willing to accept Zhang Fei.

After they stopped kissing, Zhong Yan caressed his cheeks, saying. "You are already in my heart, Fei'er. But for now, I'm still not ready to be with you, and I still need time to accept your situation and our relationship. So please give me time, and when I'm ready to accept everything, then I will surely give myself to you."
"En, you don't have to worry." Zhang Fei nodded to her and rubbed her cheek. "I will wait for you until you are ready to accept everything, Yan."
"En." Zhong Yan nodded with a sweet smile.
Zhang Fei then turned to Ru Xue and pulled her into his arms; he kissed her for a moment before speaking to them. "Anyway, I want you two to come with me somewhere else tonight."

"Sorry, I already have an appointment with my client tonight, so I can't come with you." Zhong Yan apologetically said. She actually wanted to come with him, but her client was very important, so she couldn't cancel their appointment.
Ru Xue then asked. "Where do you want to take me to? Then what about Ling'er?"
"Of course, Ling'er will come with us, and you will know where we are going later." With a chuckle, Zhang Fei stated.
After that, Zhong Yan escorted Ru Xue back to her house, then she brought Zhang Fei back to his grandmother's house.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Conflict
paragraphs: Zhang Chen was talking to the two women in the living room, since the three policemen were Hong Yao's men, so she told her that Zhang Fei had already killed them.

They were shocked to hear that, and Hong Yao couldn't help but sigh in her heart. 'Sigh, this is all Zhang Hai's fault; if it wasn't for him, then they wouldn't need to have died, I don't know what to do now about their deaths.'
Soon, Zhang Hai, Zhang He, and Chen Xin walked into the house, and Zhang Chen immediately asked her son coldly. "What do you mean by paying those cops to arrest Fei'er?"
"Mother-"

"You don't have to bother denying it; my subordinates have already admitted that you paid them to arrest Zhang Fei, Mr. Zhang." Hong Yao interrupted Zhang Hai directly. "Since they even dared to fake an arrest warrant against Zhang Fei on your orders, I have dismissed them from their positions."
Since it was impossible for her to say that Zhang Fei had killed the three policemen, Hong Yao was forced to tell him that.

Zhang Hai froze after hearing that, and he was too speechless to answer them. While Zhang He was darkened by their words, he was still angry at what Zhang Fei had done to him. and Chen Xin could only sigh in her heart, as she had no right to interfere.
Qing Yi, who had made up her mind, spoke to her husband directly. "I apologize to you, but I have already decided to divorce you, Zhang Hai."
"What!?" The father and son exclaimed in shock upon hearing that.

Zhang Hai wanted to say something, but Qing Yi hurriedly said again. "Mother has agreed with my decision to divorce you, and I have contacted my lawyer to arrange our divorce. To be honest, I regret supporting your decision to abandon and disown Fei'er two years ago, but I couldn't refuse you because I was too scared of you.
However, the situation is different now, and I won't be scared of you anymore."
Zhang Hai's face darkened at his wife's words. Zhang He also couldn't believe that his mother would decide on such a thing, and Chen Xin laughed in her heart at Qing Yi's decision.
"I'm really disappointed in you, and your actions towards Fei'er have gone too far, Hai'er." Zhang Chen expressed her disappointment. "Since-"
*Tap... Tap...*
Suddenly, they heard footsteps and looked outside, and they saw Zhang Fei walking into the house hand in hand with Zhong Yan; they all had different reactions to their closeness.

Zhang Hai raised his eyebrows, seeing them so intimately; as an active person in the business world, he naturally recognized Zhong Yan. Moreover, his company cooperated with her, and she also helped him a lot. 'How did he get together with her?'
Zhang Chen and Qing Yi also recognized Zhong Yan, but they really didn't expect that Zhang Fei had such a relationship with her, and both smiled.

Hong Yao, as the police chief, must have recognized Zhong Yan, and their relationship took her by surprise. Since no man had managed to get close to her before, but she fell into the demon's arms now.

Zhang He, who had also met Zhong Yan several times, looked at them enviously. Meanwhile, seeing their intimacy filled Chen Xin with jealousy, especially since she was much prettier, sexier, and richer than her.
Zhang Fei's lips curled in response to their reaction, and he casually asked his father. "Are you surprised that I'm not in prison, Zhang Hai?"

Zhang Hai's expression darkened upon hearing Zhang Fei call him directly by his name, Zhang He also darkened upon hearing that, but he didn't dare to utter a single word, as he was still frightened by him.

Before Zhang Hai opened his mouth to scold Zhang Fei, Zhong Yan suddenly spoke to him. "I would like to inform you that I have decided to terminate our company's cooperation, Mr. Zhang. You don't need to ask me the reason because you already know the answer. Besides, I give you one month to repay your debts to me. Otherwise, I will take this matter to court."
Zhang Hai froze at her words, and he looked at her with dismay and disbelief. If she really did that, then his company would definitely collapse. "Zhong Yan-"
"You don't have to bother begging me." Zhong Yan stopped him from speaking further. "Even if your company is going to collapse, then it's none of my business."

Qing Yi sighed inwardly; since she had always been helping her husband in his company, she knew very well how crucial Zhong Yan's role was in it. 'Perhaps this is the best way to make him realize that wealth is not everything.'

Seeing that his father's reaction was so bad, Zhang He realized that they were in a pinch, and he then pointed his finger at Zhang Fei as he shouted angrily. "You! You are a jinx! It happened because of you!"

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows, and in a blink of an eye, he was already standing in front of Zhang He. He then strangled his neck tightly and lifted his body high, and he said it coldly. "Looks like my previous lesson didn't deter you, huh?"
"Fei'er!" Qing Yi and Zhang Chen cried out in shock upon seeing that.
"Let go of my son!"
"Let go of my husband, Fei!"
Zhang Hai and Chen Xin also shouted at him as they tried to free Zhang He's neck from his strangulation, but Zhang Fei was strangling his neck very tightly.
*Swish*
Zhang Fei used his qi to push them away, Zhang Hai and Chen Xin instantly fell backwards, and they were shocked to see that.
Zhang He's face was extremely red, and he struggled to breathe, as Zhang Fei's grip on his neck tightened.

"I told you before, right? If you seek trouble with me again, then I will not hesitate to kill you." Zhang Fei spoke very coldly, and he strangled his neck tighter, making it even harder for Zhang He to breathe.
Zhang Hai and Chen Xin were horrified by his words because they had no idea Zhang Fei was an incubus as well as a fox.
Zhang Chen immediately stood up to them, then she grabbed Zhang Fei's hand. "That's enough, Fei'er. You don't need to do something like this to him."

"Alright." Zhang Fei nodded, and then he threw Zhang He on the floor. "You'd better engrave it in your little brain about today's events, and don't you ever think that I don't dare to kill you; I didn't kill you this time just because of Grandma's request."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately entered his room. Zhong Yan also said goodbye to them, and she left Zhang Chen's house right after.
Zhang Hai and Chen Xin immediately helped Zhang He to stand up. Moreover, he seemed to be still struggling to breathe.
"Cough... Cough..." Zhang He choked hard, his eyes continued to stare at Zhang Fei's room, and his heart was filled with hatred for him even more.

Zhang Chen sighed softly, she still couldn't believe that Zhang Fei could be that strong and vicious. Luckily, he was still willing to listen to her words. She then looked at Zhang Hai, Zhang He, and Chen Xin one by one before finally saying. "From today onwards, you guys are not welcome in this house anymore, and I ask you all to leave this house right now."
They looked at Zhang Chen in disbelief, but then they returned to their rooms to pack their things. Before long, they left the house without saying goodbye.
After they left, Qing Yi pulled her mother-in-law to sit down and massaged her shoulders. "Are you all right, Mother?"
"I'm fine, Yi'er." Zhang Chen replied with a nod, but even so, she still felt sad in her heart.
"Anyway, I'm returning to the city first; I need to clear up the deaths of my three subordinates." After saying that, Hong Yao hurriedly left Zhang Chen's house.

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Chu Sisters's Longing
paragraphs: "What's wrong, Grandma?" Zhang Fei asked as his grandmother and mother walked into his room.
Zhang Chen motioned for Qing Yi to sit beside him on the bed and then spoke to him. "Fei'er, I want you to take your mother there with us tonight."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows upon hearing that, but he actually still didn't want to bring Qing Yi to the Sky Jade Realm.
Qing Yi could only sigh in her heart seeing his reaction, but she had no intention of saying anything to him, and she wanted to try to get his forgiveness first.

"Yi'er has already decided to divorce your father, so she will be living with us from now on." Hearing that, Zhang Fei turned to Qing Yi in surprise; he didn't expect that his mother had decided to divorce his father. Zhang Chen then continued. "Even though you haven't been able to forgive her, but you two have a special relationship now.
So, in my opinion, you should also take her there so that she can assist you later."

Since Zhang Fei continued to hesitate, Mei immediately advised him. [Master, your grandmother's words are true. If your mother becomes a cultivator, then she can help you improve your cultivation. Moreover, if you do it with her in your incubus form, the female essence you get from her is too little, so it would be best if you dual cultivate with her.]
Zhang Fei sighed deeply and nodded in agreement. "Alright, she can come with us tonight."
"Good." Zhang Chen nodded in satisfaction at her grandson's decision, then she left them.
After that, Zhang Fei asked his mother. "Why did you suddenly decide to divorce him?"

Qing Yi lay down on the bed and laid her head on her son's lap. "I'm sick of his attitude and harsh treatment of me. Moreover, you are still my son, and I don't like his actions of wanting to put you in jail."
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed. He then laid down next to his mother and silently hugged her. Qing Yi also didn't say anything else, and she hugged him back.
Meanwhile, Chu Qing, who was cultivating with Chu Ying and Zhang Lin, suddenly grumbled. "It's been more than a day, but Fei still hasn't come here."
Since it was afternoon on Earth, it was another day in the Sky Jade Realm, and Chu Qing couldn't wait to meet the original Zhang Fei.

Hearing her little sister's words, Chu Ying opened her eyes, and her gaze was filled with longing. Ever since the events of that night, she had been constantly thinking about Zhang Fei, and she found it difficult to focus on cultivating. chapters.title: Chapter 56: Sky Jade Realm Again
paragraphs: When Zhang Fei arrived at his grandmother's house, Ru Xue and Xu Ling'er had also just arrived.
Xu Ling'er then ran and jumped towards him, and he immediately carried her. Ru Xue simply smiled at them; she was overjoyed to see her daughter so close to him.
"Hehe, I missed you, Big Brother." Xu Lin'er said as she hugged Zhang Fei's neck.
"I miss you too, Ling'er. Did your mother tell you we're going somewhere else?"
"Yes, Mom told me, and I can't wait to go with you."
"Good!" Zhang Fei then hugged Ru Xue's waist and led them into the house, where Zhang Chen and Qing Yi were already waiting for them.
Seeing them, Zhang Chen then asked. "So when are you two getting married?"
They were stunned by her question; they had not thought about it themselves, not to mention that Ru Xue and Xu Xuan's divorce was still in process.
Xu Ling'er giggled and said. "I will be very happy if Mom and Big Brother get married soon, Grandma!"
Zhang Chen nodded in agreement; she also thought it would be great if they got married soon, especially since Zhang Fei had so many women by his side.

Hearing that, Qing Yi felt conflicted.On the one hand, she was his mother. On the other hand, she was also had an incestuous relationship with him, but their relationship could not be officially disclosed.

"Unfortunately, we can't get married yet; my divorce from Xu Xuan is still not finalized, Aunt Chen." Ru Xue replied with a soft sigh, but she also felt strange about their relationship. She used to refer to Zhang Chen as her aunt, but she was also Zhang Fei's grandmother.
"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding; she also knew that it would take them at least a month to finalize their divorce.

Zhang Fei only smiled at that; he then decided to buy 5 sets of universal clothes, which cost a total of 1,250,000 yuan. He used one and gave the other four to them, and he explained how to use them to them.

"Wow! This is really amazing, Big Brother!" Xu Ling'er exclaimed in admiration as her cloth became like an ancient dress; Zhang Chen and the others were the same; they were extremely amazed by the Universal Cloth, for it could change as they wished.
"Are you guys ready?"

"En, we are ready." They answered in unison, and their eyes were filled with curiosity, especially after Zhang Fei told them that their destination was another world, except for Zhang Chen, since she had already met the Chu Sisters.

"We will spend two days in the Sky Jade Realm, but only twelve hours will pass in this world." They nodded in understanding, and then Zhang Fei ordered Mei. 'Open the gate to the Sky Jade Realm, Mei.'
[Roger!]
Soon, a white gate opens in front of them. Qing Yi, Ru Xue, and Xu Ling'er are surprised to see it.
"You guys can enter now; this gate will lead us to the Sky Jade Realm."

They nodded and walked through the gate, Zhang Feli then followed them while carrying Xu Ling'er in his arms. He didn't forget to change into his half-fox form, because only the Chu Sisters had ever seen his human form.
Chu Clan - Back Garden

Liu Hua, who was cultivating, suddenly opened her eyes because she felt the Qi change in the surrounding area. Her eyes instantly lit up, and a sweet smile appeared on her face when she saw a white portal appear not far in front of her; then she flew in front of it and waited.
"Huh!?" Liu Hua was surprised as the three women exited the portal.
The three women were also momentarily stunned when they saw Liu Hua, and they didn't know what to say to her, but they were truly amazed at Liu Hua's flawless beauty and sexiness.
"Fei'er!" Liu Hua called out when she saw Zhang Fei coming out of the portal, and she immediately went over to him.
Xu Ling'er immediately jumped down from his embrace and stood beside her mother, and Liu Hua immediately hugged him. "I missed you."
"I missed you too, Hua'er." Zhang Fei hugged her and gently caressed her back.

Zhang Chen and Ru Xue were completely stunned by Liu Hua; even though Zhang Fei had already told them about Liu Hua, they didn't expect that her beauty was truly stunning. Moreover, her face still looked like that of a woman in her twenties.

Hearing that, Zhang Lin, who was cultivating, also opened her eyes, and she smiled looking at them, especially her mother. Then she went to her mother and whispered. 'Has my big brother forgiven you, Mom?'
'He's not willing to forgive me yet, Lin'er.' Qing Yi replied with a shake of the head.

Seeing them embrace passionately, she also just noticed Zhang Fei's half-fox form. Xu Ling'er then tugged on her mother's arm. 'Hey, Mom. Who is she? Why is she so lovey-dovey with Big Brother? Moreover, why does he look like a fox?'

Ru Xue sighed softly, although Zhang Fei had already told her that he had several women, but it was his first time with Liu Hua. She then picked up her daughter and answered. 'Fei'er has changed, and he has become completely different from before, and that is one of his forms. As for that woman, I believe she is Liu Hua, and she is one of his women.'
'Hmm?' Xu Ling'er's expression became angry upon hearing that; she did not expect that Zhang Fei had another woman besides her mother.
Ru Xue hurriedly spoke again. 'You don't need to be mad at him; he already explained everything to me, and I decided to accept his situation.'
Xu Ling'er simply nodded. 'I have to talk to Big Brother later!'
A few moments later, they let go of their embrace, and Zhang Fei introduced her to them. "She is Liu Hua, and she is one of my women."

"She is my grandmother Zhang Chen, and she is my mother Qing Yi." Zhang Fei introduced them while pointing at them one by one, then he hugged Ru Xue's waist. "She is Ru Xue, and she is also one of my women. Whereas this little girl is Xu Ling'er, and she is her daughter."

"Nice to meet you, Sister Ru Xue." Ru Xue simply replied with a nod and a smile, and Liu Hua then rubbed Xu Ling'er's head. "Although you are still very young, you are already as beautiful as your mother, Ling'er."
"You are very beautiful yourself, Aunt Hua." Even though Xu Ling'er was angry at her, she still answered her with a smile.
Liu Hua then approached another woman. "Nice to meet you, Aunt Chen, Sister Qing Yi."
"Nice to meet you too, Hua'er/Sister Hua." Zhang Chen and Qing Yi replied, and they were quite surprised that Liu Hua was so kind and friendly, especially since she was a strong cultivator.
"Where-"
Zhang Fei had not had time to ask yet, but they had already heard a woman calling out to him from afar. "Fei!"

"I don't know people in that field, but I'm sure that Big Sis knows a lot of cooks, so we'll ask her later."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, they then carried the mattresses, pillows, and bolsters to their respective rooms, and they waited for Liu Qingyu to meet them.
Meanwhile, Chu Hong was chatting with Liu Qingyu in their room, but his expression suddenly changed after he received a voice transmission from someone.
"What happened, husband? Why did your expression suddenly become bad?"

Chu Hong sighed. "I just received news from Mother, the seal in the Northern Demon Cave is starting to fade, so they need a lot of help strengthening the seal, and maybe I'll be gone for quite a while this time."

"Sigh, it has been a long time since those demons from other realm ran rampant in this realm." Liu Qingyu sighed heavily. "En, please be careful, husband." Liu Qingyu replied with a nod.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Sect And Region
paragraphs: Zhang Fei and Chu Ying walked hand in hand while following Chu Qing and Zhang Ling, who were busy buying various kinds of snacks and goods. He himself had already changed to his true form, as he didn't want to make a fuss by walking around the city in his half-fox form.
Seeing Chu Ying remain silent while lowering her head, Zhang Fei embraced her and asked. "What are you thinking, Ying'er?"
Chu Ying shyly leaned her head against his shoulder, and she whispered with a blush on her face. 'I want you to sleep in my room tonight, Fei.'

"Alright then, I'll sleep in your room tonight." Zhang Fei replied without hesitation; in fact, he was impatient to take Chu Ying as his partner. "Anyway, Ying, could you tell me about the Sky Jade Realm? I want to know about the territories, sects, and ruling families of this realm."

Chu Ying nodded, and then she began to explain to him. Basically, the Sky Jade Realm is divided into five regions: the Northern Barren Region, where the Demon Cave is located; the Eastern Desert Region; the Western Forest Region; the Southern River Region; and finally, the Central Region.
The western region itself is inhabited by three major clans: the Chu Clan, the Zhao Clan, and the Ye Clan. Apart from the three major clans, there were several minor clans, such as the Li Clan.

Similarly, the Eastern Desert and Southern River Region, both of which have three major clans. The strongest clan in the Southern River Region was the Liu Clan, while the strongest clan in the Eastern Desert Region was the Guo Clan.

As for the Northern Barren Region, it was a completely barren place with no inhabitants. At first, the place was no different from any other region, but suddenly the Demon Cave appeared out of nowhere, and the demons that emerged from the cave destroyed the place.
According to rumors circulating outside, the Pang Clan resides in the Northern Barren Region, but no one has been able to find their clan's location.

As for the Central Region, there are also several major clans there. They are the Chang Clan, the Zhang Clan, the Feng Clan, the Lan Clan, and the Di Clan. But the strongest among them was the Chang Clan, and the Chang Clan was also the strongest clan in the entire Sky Jade Realm.
And in the Sky Jade Realm, there were only six sects in total.
>Central Region
1. Blazing Phoenix Sect
>Eastern Desert Region
2. Desolate Sect
>Southern River Region
3. Hidden Sea Palace
4. Yin-Yang Pavilion
>Western Forest Region
5. Heavenly Sword Sect
> Northern Barren Region
6. Northern Demon Gate (Pang Clan)
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after Chu Ying finished explaining everything, but he didn't expect that the Liu and Chu clans were two of the major clans in the Sky Jade Realm.
However, there was one sect that piqued his interest, the Yin-Yang Pavilion, because it was a dual cultivation sect.

[Are you interested in joining the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Master?] Mei asked in a teasing tone. [If you join the sect, then you can get a lot of dual cultivation partners, and that way your cultivation can definitely increase faster.]
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed. 'But you forgot that I have to return to earth often, so I can't join any sect for now, Mei.'

Hearing that, Mei giggled. [Hehe, did you forget about your body double, Master? Since your original body has to go back and forth between the two realms, so you can use your body double to join the Yin-Yang Pavilion.]
Zhang Fei was stunned for a moment and then laughed wryly. 'Ha ha! I didn't forget about it, but I didn't think that far ahead because Tang Rou and Cheng Yu were next to my body double.'
[Those two women's cultivations are quite high right now, but they won't be able to help you forever, so I think you should join the Yin-Yang Pavilion as soon as possible, Master.]
'Then what about Tang Rou and Cheng Yu if I join the sect? There's no way I could bring them to the sect, right?'
[Hmm? The only way is for you to increase your female essence; that way, you can upgrade your demon body double to the second level, and you can make a second body double.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, and he felt that there was no other way, but for that he need other women.
"Are you interested in joining the Yin-Yang Pavilion?" Chu Ying suddenly asked, as Zhang Fei seemed lost in thought; moreover, she also knew that he was a dual cultivator.
"En, I am indeed interested in joining the Yin-Yang Pavilion." Zhang Fei answered bluntly.
Chu Ying was not surprised by his answer. "In that case, you can use your body double to join the Yin-Yang Pavilion."
"Yes, I'm thinking of doing that too." Zhang Fei replied with a grateful smile; he felt grateful that Chu Ying and the others did not reject him as a dual cultivator and instead supported him.

'Actually, how big is this Sky Jade Realm, Mei?' Zhang Fei asked curiously. According to Chu Ying's story, there are only three cities in the Western Forest Region, but the cities are indeed very large.

Mei immediately answered based on the results of her previous scan. [In reality, Master, the size of this Sky Jare Realm is the same as that of Earth. If the earth is dominated by water, then this realm is dominated by land. However, this realm is teeming with beasts, whether on land, in the sky, or at sea.
So they make it difficult for people to travel to other regions, and it takes a very long time to go to other regions.]

'This realm is still really big!' Zhang Fei inwardly expressed surprise, and he continued to chat with Mei, as he followed the three women, who seemed happy to stroll around the city, especially Zhang Lin. 'Then what about this Western Forest Region itself, Mei?'
[Just as Chu Ying said earlier, there are only three cities in this region. Two cities outside the forest and a city located deep within the forest, Master.]
Zhang Fei was quite interested in the city in the forest. He felt that it should be more interesting than the two cities outside the forest, and he really wanted to go to the there.

Mei then spoke again. [Anyway, if you want to hunt beasts, then this region is the right place, Master. Because three-quarters of this region is covered with forest and the types of beasts in this region are more varied than those in other regions.]
'En, I got it.' Zhang Fei nodded in agreement; he did need to hunt beasts again, especially the white-tailed deer, since it was the main meat that Zhong Yan needed for her restaurant.
Seeing Zhang Fei who seemed engrossed in his own thoughts, Chu Ying then hugged his arms and asked him. "Isn't there anything that interests you?"
"Nothing interesting to me." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head.

paragraphs: "Nothing interesting to me." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head.

However, things have changed now, and the items that interest him are in his shop system. But unfortunately, he still didn't have enough money, jewels, or female essence to buy them.
That was why he really wanted to establish a two-way trade between the Earth and the Sky Jade Realm; that way he could collect them all faster.

But the problem for him now is his female essence, because at this moment there are only seven women who know his identity as an incubus, but he can only have sex using his incubus form with one of the seven women.

Qing Yi and Ru Xue were already cultivators; he would definitely dual cultivate with them in his human form. Zhang Chen was his grandmother, so he couldn't possibly do it with her. Zhang Lin still had to wait to form her core, Zhong Yan was also still not willing to accept him, and Xu Ling'er was only ten years old, so the only woman left was Hong Yao.
As for Chen Xin, although he can use her to get female essence, she will return to Guangzhou soon.
"Then what interests you, Fei?" Chu Ying asked again with a flushed face, as she thought that only sex could attract Zhang Fei's interest.

'This girl! Does she really think I'm only interested in sex?' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he looked at Chu Ying with amusement, then he said. "Actually, I feel interested in going to the city in the forest. Is it possible for us to go to that city?"

"Huh? It's impossible for the two of us to go to that city, Fei. Even I've only been to that city once." Chu Ying replied with a shake of her head. "The city in the forest is too mysterious, and not everyone can go there. But if you are really interested in going to the city, then you can go with Mom or Aunt Hua."

Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Zhang Lin stared at them strangely; even the merchant became awkward seeing them like that.

After a few minutes, Chu Qing couldn't stand seeing them like that anymore, and she felt extremely jealous of Hu Yue. She gave a mischievous smirk, then hugged Zhang Fei from behind and asked softly. "Do you like this woman, Fei?"

Hearing Chu Qing's question, they came back to their senses. But just as Hu Yue was about to pull her hand away from Zhang Fei's cheek, he immediately grabbed her hand and instantly used his teleportation ability.
Chu Qing, who was hugging Zhang Fei's body, almost fell over because of it, but luckily Chu Ying quickly caught her.
Chu Qing stomped her foot on the ground, grumbling furiously. "That damn seductress! She must have used the charm technique on Fei!"
Chu Ying and Zhang Lin laughed softly at her reaction, then Zhang Lin said. "Actually, I've never seen Big Brother react like that to the opposite sex; it seems he's really attracted to that woman."
"En." Chu Ying nodded in agreement. "He was very casual when we first met, unlike his attitude towards that woman."
"What if Fei gets entangled by that woman's temptation, Big Sis, Lin?" Chu Qing spoke with concern and rage. She was terrified that Zhang Fei would fall into Hu Yue's trap and forget about her.
"Your reaction is too exaggerated, Qing'er." Chu Ying said, shaking her head.
Unlike her little sister, Chu Ying was even more worried that Hu Yue would be enchanted by his charm, as she herself had already felt the terrifyingness of Zhang Fei's charm.

Zhang Lin nodded in agreement, as she already knew for sure about Zhang Fei's incubus identity as well as his demon charm. So she was also sure that Zhang Fei would not be ensnared by Hu Yue, but instead she would be ensnared by him. "You don't have to worry about Big Brother, Qing. The merchant couldn't help but smile bitterly because Hu Yue had not paid for the piece of iron, but he also didn't dare charge it to Chu Ying and the others.
Meanwhile, two women are standing on the roof watching them; they are none other than the Wen Twins.

At first, they were helping Liu Hua prepare the building that would become Zhang Fei's shop, but when she saw him and the others strolling through the city, she ordered the Wen Twins to follow and protect them.
"His innate ability is really weird, Yuan." Wen Xuan sighed to herself after she couldn't find Zhang Fei's whereabouts.
Wen Yuan nodded in agreement. "Since we can't find him, it's better for us to protect the three of them, especially that girl named Zhang Lin."

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Training
paragraphs: "Cough... Cough..." Zhang Fei coughed hard after his chest was hit by Wen Yuan's hard kick, he then wiped the blood that was dripping from the corner of his mouth. 'Damn it! Even though they didn't use their qi to attack me, but their attacks were quite painful. Fortunately, my physique is not only human but also demon and beast. Otherwise, I've been severely injured by their attack.'
After Zhang Fei dual cultivated with the three women, he directly asks Liu Hua to call the Wen twins, and he asks them to train him.

At first, the Wen twins didn't want to do it, as they were afraid of overdoing it and hurting him. It was because they weren't ordinary cultivators; they were assassin cultivators, so they weren't used to training someone.

However, Zhang Fei kept forcing them to train him, and Liu Hua, who saw the strong determination in his eyes, also convinced them, so they finally gave in to her persuasion and started training Zhang Fei.

The Wen twins were taken aback by Zhang Fei's physique endurance and strength; despite their attacks landing on his body multiple times, he didn't appear to have suffered any serious injuries; instead, they felt their hands go numb as they punched his body.
'How can he have such a strong body?' The Wen twins inwardly wondered.
Apart from his three physiques, Zhang Fei had also cultivated Heavenly Body Tempering to the first stage, which made his physique even stronger than that of normal cultivators.

"Fei'er, your endurance and strength are incredible, but your body is still too stiff, and you still have to hone your instincts." Liu Hua, who was watching them from the side, spoke slowly to Zhang Fei.

"In battle, don't let your emotions take control over you; if you are controlled by your emotions, then you will act rashly, and you will definitely waste many opportunities to attack your opponent. You must be able to remain calm, be patient, and observe their movements closely. If you see an opening in their attack, then you immediately attack them through that opening.
But you must not be satisfied if one of your attacks hits them; you must continue attacking and pressing them without giving them a chance to fight back."

Mei then also said. [What Liu Hua said is true, Master. Even if you don't have any fighting techniques yet, you have demon eyes that can instill fear in your enemies; your senses are also five times sharper than other cultivators; and you also have teleportation techniques.
Your biggest weakness is your emotions, so you have to calm yourself down first, and if you manage to do that, then you won't have any trouble fighting them.]
Zhang Fei fell silent. He then closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and digested their words.
Liu Hua and the Wen Twins were also silent, and they continued to observe Zhang Fei. After a few minutes, they raised their eyebrows as they felt an extraordinary calmness radiate from him.
'You are indeed amazing, Fei'er. I really didn't misjudge you, you can even understand the meaning of my words quickly.' Liu Hua inwardly muttered happily, and a satisfied smile appeared on her face.
The Wen twins glanced at each other, and they smiled at Zhang Fei, who looked so calm.
Before long, Zhang Fei opened his eyes; he became much calmer than before, and his gaze seemed to be filled with serenity. "Let's continue again, Yuan, Xuan."
The Wen Twins nodded, then they disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight.
Unlike before, Zhang Fei didn't move carelessly, and he seemed to blend in with his surroundings.
In the next second, the Wen twins appeared simultaneously behind Zhang Fei, and they attempted to kick him.
But at the same time, Zhang Fei also used his teleportation ability and moved behind the Wen twins, then he used his Demon Eyes on them.
Instantly, the Wen twins shuddered as Zhang Fei activated his Demon Eyes, and they felt a chill run down their spines, but suddenly they were blown forward by his kick on their backs.
The Wen Twins immediately stabilized themselves, and they landed quite a distance from where they were before. But when they looked ahead, Zhang Fei had already disappeared from their sight.
Liu Hua smiled because he saw Zhang Fei already standing behind the Wen twins, but they still didn't notice his presence. 'Looks like he's starting to get a good grasp of the use of his techniques.'
*Slap... Slap...*
"Damn it, Zhang Fei!" The Wen twins cursed loudly as soon as a hard slap landed on their buttocks, but by the time they turned around, he had already disappeared from behind them.
'Weird! Why can't I feel his aura at all? He seemed to have completely disappeared.' The Wei twins thought in their hearts, as they continued to search for Zhang Fei's whereabouts.

While they were busy searching for Zhang Fei's whereabouts, he suddenly appeared in their midst and pecked their cheeks, then he teleported again quickly. The Wen Twins were dumbfounded, and they rubbed their cheeks with flushed faces.
*clasp...*

"Enough playing around, Fei." Zhang Fei then appeared beside Liu Hua and hugged her waist. "I really didn't expect your comprehension to be so high, Fei. In a short time, you can understand my words well, and you can even apply them directly."

"Not really." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "Calmness, that's the main point I got from your words. Then I thought, how about making myself as calm as possible, then blending my presence with the surroundings? And that's what happened just now. But I still can't control my emotions completely, and I can't wait to attack them."
"But it's already very good, Zhang Fei!" Wen Xuan said as she approached them. "Me and Yuan couldn't even detect your whereabouts just now."

"That's right, Zhang Fei. You just need some time to hone yourself," Wen Yuan added, nodding in agreement. "If you are familiar with everything, then you will become an outstanding assassin in the future."
"An assassin, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself, and he smiled at the thought. "Anyway, Hua'er, lend me your weapon; I want to hunt some beasts."

After that, Zhang Fei asked Mei to find some beasts that matched his cultivation, and he immediately hunted beasts for a long time. Meanwhile, Liu Hua and the Wen Twins just watch him do it, while they stand guard to help him if he encounters a beast stronger than him.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Chu Ying's Suitor
paragraphs: Chu Clan - Main Hall
While Zhang Fei was hunting beasts, two young men came to visit the Chu Clan, and both were quite handsome.
One young man has long black hair, is dressed in all black, has a tall and slender build, and has an overly serious expression.

While the other young man had shoulder-length brown hair and was dressed all in green, his body wasn't too tall, and he was also a little chubby; moreover, his expression was more childish and playful.
They didn't seem to like each other, but they both came with the same goal.

"I apologize for my sudden arrival, Aunt Qingyu." The young man with long black hair spoke first very politely. "But I have liked Chu Ying for a long time, so today I have come to ask for her hand, and I hope that you will agree to it, Aunt Qingyu."

"Don't agree to his request, Aunt Qingyu." The shoulder-length, brown-haired young man interrupted. "I also came here to ask for Chu Ying's hand, Aunt Qingyu. I have also liked her for a long time, and I am sure that she will be much happier if she is with me."

Liu Qingyu, who was sitting in front of them, couldn't help but shake her head at their antics; actually, she already knew that they both liked her eldest daughter for a long time, but she never responded to their feelings. In addition, there was now a third man present among them, and it was clear that she was deeply in love with the third man.

"Unfortunately, I have to refuse the request of the two of you, Ye Hang and Zhao Yun." Lin Qingyu replied with a soft sigh, and they looked at her in disbelief, then she continued. "I've known for a long time that you two like my daughter, but Ying'er never liked you two. Moreover, she has now chosen another man as her husband, and my husband has also agreed to their relationship."
"What!?" Ye Hang and Zhao Yun shouted in shock at the same time, and their eyes widened in disbelief.
The young man with shoulder-length brown hair then said. "Tell me the identity of that man, Aunt Qingyu. I want to challenge him to a fight; if he loses, he must leave Chu Ying!"
"You really are being disrespectful, Fatty Ye!" Zhao Yun scolded Ye Hang.
Ye Hang just snorted at him. "Humph!"
Zhao Yun shook his head, and then he asked Liu Qingyu. "Can I meet Chu Ying and her future husband, Aunt Qingyu?"
"They-"
Before Liu Qingyu answered him, Chu Ying had already walked in, as she asked. "Why do you want to meet me, Zhao Yun? My mother already explained to you two about my future husband, right?"

Chu Ying then sat leisurely beside Liu Qingyu, and she did not look at them at all. In fact, she had always felt uncomfortable around them, as they had always been exaggerating when they tried to get close to her, especially Ye Hang.

"Hey, Chu Ying! Call that man here; let us fight to determine who is the best among us and the best man who deserves to be your husband." Ye Hang said arrogantly. As a young master of the Ye Clan, he is indeed famous for being unruly and arrogant.
Unlike Ye Hang, Zhao Yun also has his arrogance, but he can also be calm and polite, and he doesn't like to boast like Ye Hang.

Chu Ying's face darkened at Ye Hang's words, and then she compared Ye Hang to Zhang Fei. "You want to know who is better? Let me tell you, Ye Hang. First, his face is much more handsome than yours. Second, your body is much fatter and shorter than him. Third, he is not a braggart like you."
"Pfft!" Zhao Yun burst out laughing at Chu Ying's words, even Liu Qingyu tried hard to hold back her laughter.
"You-"

"You what?" Chu Ying interrupted him with a sneer. "Everyone in this city thinks of you that way too, you know? Do you think you can do as you please by relying on your Ye Clan? Even the Chu and Liu Clans are much better than your Ye Clan, but I have never boasted about my clans like you."
Ye Hang was speechless, and he couldn't refute Chu Ying's words because the Chu and Liu clans were indeed far superior to the Ye Clan.

"Humph!" Chu Ying snorted at Ye Hang, then she turned to Zhao Yun. "As you have heard from my mother, Zhao Yun. I have already chosen my husband, so I hope you can accept the facts, and there are many other women out there who like you."
Zhao Yun couldn't help but sigh, and he nodded to her. "I understand, Chu Ying. Then-"
"Mom! Big sis!"
Chu Qing suddenly ran into the main hall carrying a Python-Tailed Tiger cub; Zhang Lin followed behind her, and she also carried a Python-Tailed Tiger cub.
"Python-Tailed Tiger Cubs!" Ye Hang and Zhao Yun exclaimed in shock when they saw the two tiger cubs in their arms.

"Why did you bring them here, Qing'er?" Liu Qingyu asked with a raised eyebrow, but she was then surprised because the two Python-Tailed Tiger cubs were already much bigger than when they were just born.
"Look closely, Mom! They're growing really fast!" Chu Qing said as she held the Python-Tailed Tiger cub in her hands, and it let out a low roar.

"En, these two tiger cubs are really weird; their growth is really fast." Liu Qingyu nodded in agreement, then she looked closely at the two tiger cubs, but she didn't find anything unusual on their bodies.
"Cough... Where did you get those two Python-Tailed Tiger cubs, Chu Qing?" Zhao Yun asked seriously, and his eyes were fixed on the two beasts.
Ye Hang was the same as him; his eyes were fixed on the two beasts, and he seemed to want to snatch the two tiger cubs from them.
"Oh, Zhao Yun?" Chu Qing turned to him in surprise, but then she replied with a proud smile. "It was Fei who got these two Python-Tailed Tiger cubs; their mother passed them to him before she died."
"Fei?" Zhao Yun and Ye Hang raised their eyebrows, as they had never heard of Zhang Fei's name before.
"En." Chu Qing nodded. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he is my husband as well as my big sister's husband."

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Ye Lian
paragraphs: "How dare you!" Ye Hang shouted and mobilized his qi to attack Zhang Fei.
Before Ye Hang attacked him, Zhang Fei had already used his teleportation, and he moved behind him. Then he threw all the White-Tailed Deer on his shoulders towards him.
*BAMM*
Ye Hang, who wasn't prepared for that, immediately fell to the ground, and his body was pinned down by them. "Guah...!"

'What the hell!? How could he move in an instant? And how did he manage to throw so many white-tailed deer so easily?' Zhao Yun was in shock, seeing Zhang Fei's strength, especially with his extremely low cultivation. It was impossible for him to be able to do such a thing; not even he himself could do something like what he did.

However, Zhao Yun didn't know anything about Zhang Fei's abilities, nor did he know that he was not just an ordinary human, but a demon and a beast as well, adding more to his Heavenly Tempering Body.
*Splurt*

Ye Hang spat out a mouthful of blood as Zhang Fei jumped onto the pile of white-tailed deer above his body, then he crouched down and looked at him with a slight smirk. "Tsk, you really are ridiculous, you know? You wanted to take Chu Ying away from me, but when I said I wanted to take the women in your clan, you got mad at me."
*Splurt*

Ye Hang's mouth spat out another mouthful of blood as Zhang Fei stomped his foot hard, then he jumped down and spoke again. "Do you think you are worthy of Chu Ying? You can't even break away from this pile of deer."

Ye Hang, who was helplessly pinned down by the pile of white-tailed deer, didn't respond; all he could do was stare at Zhang Fei with rage and hatred; as the Young Master of the Ye Clan, he had never been humiliated like this before. 'I will definitely take revenge for your humiliation today a hundredfold!'
Zhang Fei just shook his head at Ye Hang, then he turned to Zhao Yun as he used his Demon Eyes for a moment and nonchalantly asked him. "Do you want to attack me too?"

"Although I really like Chu Ying, I would not do such a thing." Zhao Yun answered, shaking his head. "I just wanted to know what kind of man Chu Ying chose as her husband, but it seems she was right in choosing you as her husband."
"Heh." Zhang Fei's lips curled up at Zhao Yun's answer. 'This man is like a wolf in sheep's clothing; although he looks relaxed, he is actually more dangerous than the Fatty.'
After that, Zhang Fei didn't say anything else, and he walked away, leaving them.

'That guy is really dangerous; I don't know what he did just now, but I was scared of him for a moment.' Zhao Yun inwardly muttered as he continued to stare at Zhang Fei, who was getting further and further away, and he clenched his sweaty hands.
*Swish*

Liu Hua waved her hand, and the pile of white-tailed deer was lifted from Ye Hang's body, after which she spoke to them. "Both of you quickly leave this place, and I warn you both not to look for trouble with Fei'er. Otherwise, I will have no qualms with your clans, and I will kill you two myself."
After she said that, Liu Hua then walked away from them, and she ordered the Chu Clan people to skin and cut all the white-tailed deer.
Zhao Yun took a deep breath; he could sense that Liu Hua wasn't joking with her words, then he turned around and left the Chu Clan, ignoring Ye Hang.

Ye Hang then rose from the ground, still staring in the direction Zhang Fei had gone, and clenched his fists tightly. 'Just wait for my revenge, Zhang Fei! I will surely humiliate you more than what you did to me today.'
Then Ye Hang walked out of the Chu Clan, holding his painful chest.
Bathing Pool

"Fei'er, you have to be careful of Zhao Yun." Liu Hua said as she helped him clean up the blood on his body. "Zhao Yun has always been calm, but he is even more terrifying than Ye Hang, and the Zhao Clan is also very mysterious; even I don't know the depth of their strength."

"Zhao Yun is indeed a wolf in sheep's clothing, and he had a dark heart." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. After he used his demon eyes on him, he could see what was hidden in his heart, which made him not dare underestimate Zhao Yun.
Liu Hua smiled with satisfaction hearing his answer, she was happy that Zhang Fei could judge his opponent well; without good judgment, he would not be able to see his opponent's weakness.
Ye Clan
As Ye Hang walked into his clan residence, a waist-length brown-haired young woman asked him with a frown. "What happened to you, little brother? Why do you look so disheveled and covered in blood?"

The young woman looked graceful in a long white dress; her posture was very tall and slender; her skin was like smooth white snow; and she also had beautiful curves, coupled with her big and round breasts, about 34D.
Her face looks so alluring and beautiful; she has wide and sharp brown eyes with slightly thick eyebrows on top and a small nose, combined with thick and sensual lips.
Ye Hang sighed and replied. "It's all because of that guy called Zhang Fei, Big Sis Lian! He threw some white-tailed deer at me, and this is the blood of the deer."

"Huh? He threw some white-tailed deer at you?" Ye Lian was taken aback; she knew white-tailed deer were heavy, but her little brother claimed that there was a man who could lift a few deer at once, let alone throw them to him. "Anyway, who is that Zhang Fei? I've never heard of his name before."
"I didn't know who he really was, but he is the husband of Chu Ying and Chu Qing." Ye Hang replied by gritting his teeth.

Ye Lian looked very surprised to hear that, and it made her wonder in her heart. 'They share a husband? I really can't believe that a woman like Chu Ying is willing to share her husband with Chu Qing.'
After that, Ye Lian asked her little brother various things about Zhang Fei, and all his explanations made her even more disbelieving and shocked. 'Hmm, I have to meet with Chu Ying later.'

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Map Feature
paragraphs: After cleaning himself up, Zhang Fei immediately started cultivating in the back garden. His encounter with Hu Yue made him eager to increase his cultivation as quickly as possible.

Even though he had already given his Demon Mark to Hu Yue, Zhang Fei still couldn't calm his restless heart because he didn't know where she was now, as she had only told him that she came from the Central Region.
But suddenly, Mei said. [Actually, you don't have to worry about Hu Yue, Master. Since you can use your map to track her whereabouts, you can also look for her whenever you want.]
Zhang Fei was taken aback by Mei's words; he finally realized that he had never tried the map feature on his system. 'Show me the map, Mei.'
[Okay!]

Zhang Fei was instantly stunned when he saw the 3D map appear in front of him, and he could see several different colored dots on the 3D map. 'Hmm? What is the difference between each of these colored dots?'

Zhang Fei then pressed all the colored dots around him; the golden dot showed his own name as well as Zhang Lin's. Then the pink dot near him displayed Ru Xue's name, and the two white dots displayed the names of Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu. As for the names of Chu Ying, Chu Qing, Zhang Chen, and Xu Ling'er, they are joined by a bunch of green dots.

Seeing that, Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows, and he could already understand the difference. 'So these golden dots are me as well as my human form partner, while the pink dots are my lust demon form partner, and the white dots are my heavenly fox form partners, right?'

[That seems to be the case, Master.] Then Mei showed him two red dots that were quite far away from him. [Those two red dots seem to be hostile toward you, Master. And all the green dots are neutral ones.]

'Heh, as expected.' Zhang Fei's lips curled up as he saw Zhou Yun and Ye Hang's names appear from the two red dots. 'Since you two think of me as your enemy, don't blame me if I do something bad to you guys later.'
Then Zhang Fei pressed a red dot that was very far from his location, and from that red dot appeared the name Pang Hong. 'He seems to really hate me, huh?'
Mei giggled at that. [How could he not hate you, Master? You thwarted his plan to capture Liu Qingyu, and you also succeeded in releasing Liu Hua from his control.]

'Fortunately, he is very far from this place; otherwise, he will definitely come after me.' Zhang Fei exhaled a sigh of relief as he noticed another pink dot, and he smiled as he saw Hu Yue's name appear from the pink dot. 'Wait for me, Yue. I will try to become strong as soon as possible, and I will definitely snatch you from their hands in the future.'
After that, Zhang Fei inhaled and exhaled air many times to calm himself down, then he closed his eyes with a relieved smile and started to cultivate normally.
Zhao Clan
A middle-aged woman with long black hair, wearing a long green dress with a purple pattern, walked up to Zhou Yun, who looked depressed and kept sighing.

Even though she was middle-aged, her face still looked young. She has slanted black eyes with two thin eyebrows; she also has a sharp nose with thin lips underneath. Her body looks a little tall and curvaceous, and her big breasts don't look slack at all.
"Why do you look so depressed, Yun'er?" The middle-aged woman asked with concern, and she then sat down beside Zhao Yun. "Didn't you go to ask for Chu Ying's hand earlier? What was the decision?"

Zhao Yun turned to her, then shook his head. "Aunt Qingyu rejected my proposal to Chu Ying, Mother. She has already chosen another man to be her husband, and they will consummate their marriage soon."

"Oh?" The middle-aged woman was Huan Ning, the mistress of the Zhao Clan. She was really surprised to hear her son's words, then she caressed his head and asked again. "Do you know the identity of that man, Yun'er? And which family did he come from?"
"His name is Zhang Fei; he-"
Zhou Yun had not finished answering her question when Huan Ning suddenly exclaimed in shock. "What did you just say, Yun'er? His name is Zhang Fei? Zhang Clan?"

"His name is indeed Zhang Fei, but I have never heard of the Zhang Clan before. Moreover, his cultivation is very low; he is still at the 10 Star Body Realm." Huan Ning's expression looked weird after she heard her son's answer. Seeing his mother's strange expression, Zhou Yun then asked. "Do you know anything about the Zhang Clan, Mother?"
"Nothing." Huan Ning replied with a shake of her head, then rose to her feet and walked away as she said. "If you really want Chu Ying as your wife, then mother will help you, Yun'er."

Zhao Yun's eyes lit up at that, and the hope of getting Chu Ying rekindled in his heart. 'I hope you can really help me, Mother. I only want Chu Ying to be my woman, for only she is worthy to be my woman.'
After leaving her son, Huan Ning returned to her room, and soon a man and a woman appeared in front of her.

They nodded at Huan Ning, then they disappeared from her sight again.

paragraphs: "Phew!" Zhang Fei exhaled slowly after he had cultivated for quite a while, and it was already night. Then he stood up from his seat and wanted to go to Chu Ying's room.

However, just as he was about to walk away, he heard the sound of people sneaking into the Chu Clan. Fortunately, Zhang Fei's hearing was five times sharper than other cultivators, so he could clearly hear them. He immediately opened his map, and he saw two red dots heading towards him. Then he saw the two names on the red dots. "Gui Yi and Gui Er?"
[It seems their target is you, Master.]
'En.' Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, but he was also curious about the identity of the person behind the two. 'Are they people from the Zhao or Ye Clans?'
[It is certain that they are subordinates of one of those clans, Master.]

Zhang Fei immediately took out two long daggers from his inventory; they were the daggers he borrowed from Liu Hua for hunting beasts earlier. He gripped the two daggers tightly and used his teleportation ability.
The man and woman raised their eyebrows when they saw Zhang Fei disappear from their sight; they glanced at each other in confusion. Suddenly, the man's mouth sprayed blood on the woman's face.

The woman's eyes widened as she saw two daggers pierce the man's chest from behind, but then she saw two blood-red eyes; she felt a tremendous amount of fear from them, and her body trembled violently.
*Splurt*
Blood immediately sprayed from the man's chest as Zhang Fei pulled out the daggers from his chest, and the man fell lifeless on the ground.
Zhang Fei strangled the woman's neck, then he lifted her body high and asked. "Who ordered you to attack me? The Zhao Clan or the Ye Clan?"
[You don't have to waste your time, Master. This woman doesn't have a tongue, so she won't be able to answer you.] Mei said after she scanned the woman's body.

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows at Mei's words, then he forcefully opened the woman's mouth, and sure enough, she didn't have a tongue. "You seem to be a well-trained assassin, huh? Unfortunately, this time you ran into the wrong person."

Just as Zhang Fei was about to stab his dagger into the woman's chest, Mei suddenly said. [This woman is still a virgin, Master. Moreover, her cultivation is at 10 Star Foundation Realm, it would be best if you take her Virgin Qi first.]
"Oh? You're still a virgin, huh?" Zhang Fei said with a vile smirk.
The woman shuddered and trembled when she saw Zhang Fei's smirk, as she still couldn't escape the fear effect his demon eyes gave her. And the next second, he took her away using his teleportation.

After they disappeared, Liu Hua and the Wen twins appeared at the place, Liu Hua then crouched down to examine the man's corpse, and he found a plaque that said Gui. "Gui Assassin Group? Why are they after Fei?"
"Are we not going after them, Big Sis?" Wen Xuan asked.

Wen Yuan answered first. "That doesn't seem necessary, Xuan. They are in the 10 Star Foundation Realm, but Zhang Fei was able to kill this man so easily, and the woman also looks helpless in front of him."

"What Yuan'er said is true, Xuan'er." Liu Hua nodded in agreement with Wen Yuan's words, but she was inwardly wondering. 'What's the matter with Fei'er's eyes? How did his eyes turn blood red? And that woman looks so frightened by his eyes.'
"If my guess is correct, Gui Assassin is related to the Zhao Clan." Liu Hua spoke as she rose to her feet.
"Do you want us to investigate them, Big Sis?" Wen Yuan asked.
"No need." Liu Hua shook her head, then she flew towards Zhang Fei's location, as she told the Wen twins. "You two stay on guard here; I will catch up with Fei."
Zhang Fei's location

Zhang Fei stood on top of the tree with the woman still shaking on his shoulders, looking at the two men below him, and Mei asked him. [Why did you bring this woman here, Master? Are you going to give this woman to them? Isn't that a loss for you?]
Zhang Fei sighed at that, and he then answered him. 'Mei, even though I'm an incubus, I'm not a rapist, so I won't do anything to this woman by myself.'
[But-]

'No buts!' Zhang Fei interrupted Mei directly and jumped down from the tree, and the two men were shocked and terrified, especially when they saw his blood red eyes. "You two don't need to be afraid of me; I came here to reward you both."
"Huh?"
"What do you mean, young master?"
Zhang Fei didn't answer them; he then used demon pheromone on them, and he also used demon touch on the woman.
"Ugh!"
"Ahn~"
The two men and the woman groaned as they inhaled Zhang Fei's demon pheromone, and the two men stared at her lustfully.
Seeing that the two men were like that, Zhang Fei threw the woman at them. "You can fuck that woman to your heart's content; I don't care if she dies."
After that, Zhang Fei jumped up a tree and waited for them to act, and he continuously used his demon pheromone on them.

Since they were already deeply affected by Zhang Fei's demon pheromone, the two men immediately approached the woman while removing their clothes, and she let the two of them strip her naked. Wasting no time, the two men lifted up the woman and sandwiched her, and they immediately thrust their erect dicks into her two holes without mercy.

"Argh!" Even though she was already very lustful, she was still a virgin, and their actions caused the woman great pain. Even so, the two men ignored her groans of pain, and they fucked her passionately.
Zhang Fei's lips curled up at them. "Heh, it was your own fault for trying to kill me, so you will have to bear the consequences."

From a distance, Liu Hua stared at the area in shock. She didn't expect that Zhang Fei would be so ruthless; he even allowed the two men to violate the woman, even though she was still a virgin. Even though she was happy about it, she also felt suspicious of him. 'Are you really a demon, Fei'er?'
Since the influence of Zhang Fei's demon pheromone was very strong, the two men fucked the woman for a full hour, and they ended up fainting from too much exhaustion.

Zhang Fei then jumped down from the tree again and checked their condition; since the woman was not dead, he took a dagger and stabbed her in the heart. After he confirmed that the woman was dead, he pulled the dagger out of his chest and took her storage ring.

However, just as Zhang Fei turned around, Liu Hua landed right in front of him. She looked directly into her blood-red eyes, then asked seriously. "Are you a demon, Fei'er? Because only a demon has blood-red eyes like you."
Zhang Fei was at a loss to answer her, but then he nodded and transformed himself into an incubus.

When Liu Hua saw Zhang Fei's incubus form, her eyes trembled; killing intent leaked from her body unknowingly, making Zhang Fei shudder. She quickly retracted her killing intent, then she asked with a disappointed tone. "Why did you hide it from me? Why didn't you tell me that you were a demon?"
"Does it make any difference to you?" Zhang Fei turned to ask in disappointment, especially after he sensed Liu Hua's killing intent.

"I just don't want you guys to hate me; that's why I hid my demon identity from all of you." Zhang Fei sighed heavily after he said that, then he continued. "I'm not lying to you about how I became a cultivator; my savior did give me a fox bloodline, but at the same time she also gave me a demon bloodline."

"Is that true?" Liu Hua asked in disbelief because she had never heard of a human having more than two bloodlines before. And as far as she knows, if any human receives another bloodline, then their human bloodline will be replaced by their new bloodline.
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I don't know how she did it to me; at this point I'm still a human, but I'm also a demon as well as a beast fox."
Liu Hua fell silent upon hearing his explanation, and she still felt disappointed in her heart because her man was a demon.

Seeing Liu Hua fall into silence made Zhang Fei feel even more disappointed, so he turned around and said. "If you feel disappointed in me, and if you can't accept my demon identity, then I will leave you all for good."
"No!" Liu Hua shouted as she hugged him from behind. "I'm really sorry; please don't leave us!"

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Marriage Plan
paragraphs: Chu Qing was seen observing and groping Zhang Fei's horns, wings, and tail. This was the first time she had seen the figure of a demon herself.

On the other hand, Liu Qingyu was observing Zhang Fei strangely; occasionally, her eyes showed a glitter of hatred. It was very natural for her, because the cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm were still traumatized by the appearance of the demons from the Demon Cave, and the demons were destroying the prosperous Northern Region and turning it barren.
As for Chu Ying, although she was shocked by Zhang Fei's demon form, her view of him didn't seem to change; she continued to look at him with affection and curiosity.
After Zhang Fei talked to Liu Hua earlier, he decided to tell the Chu Clan the truth about his demon identity, and he was prepared to risk losing them.

If indeed the Chu Clan was unable to accept his demon identity, then he intended to take Zhang Chen, Zhang Lin, Ru Xue, Qing Yi, and Xu Ling'er back to earth. And he would only bring them back to the Sky Jade Realm again when he found a better place for them later.
Before long, Liu Qingyu sighed heavily; she then asked Zhang Chen and the others. "Did you guys know about his demon identity before?"

"En, I've known about it before, Qingyu." Zhang Chen replied with a nod, and the other women also nodded at her. She then continued. "After all, Fei'er is my grandson, and he wasn't a demon by birth, but that accident turned him into a demon as well as a fox."

"Fei's identity as a demon shouldn't be a problem for us, right, Mom?" Chu Qing said this while groping Zhang Fei. "If it wasn't for him, then you would have fallen into Pang Hong's hands by now, and Aunt Hua would still be under his control as well."

"What Qing'er said is true, Mom." Chu Ying finally joined in. "Fei became a demon not because of his will, but because it was his savior who turned him into a demon and a fox, so we can't compare him to the demons from the Demon Cave. Moreover, he also never did anything bad to us; instead, he saved you and Aunt Hua."

Liu Qingyu understood her daughter's words, and knowing she owed Zhang Fei, she spoke again. "As for Fei's demon identity, don't let others know about it, especially your father; otherwise, he will definitely kill him."
Chu Qing and Chu Ying nodded in agreement. Liu Hua also agreed with her big sister because she knew that Chu Hong really hated demons.
"Thank you for your understanding, guys." Zhang Fei exhaled a sigh of relief. Even though he was already prepared to let them go, he was also afraid of losing them.
"Hehe, I really like seeing your demon form, Fei." Chu Qing spoke as she rubbed Zhang Fei's horn. "Your horns are really unique and interesting, especially your wings and tail."
"Ugh!" Zhang Fei moaned as Chu Qing held the tip of his tail, because that was the most sensitive part of his incubus form.
Chu Qing was startled by his mother; she immediately let go of his tail and asked in confusion. "What's going on, Fei? Why are you moaning?"
"That's-"
"That's because Big Brother feels pleasure." Zhang Lin spoke first, and she then pulled Chu Qing to come with her. "Come with me, I will teach you many things, Qing."
'I'm waiting for you in my room, Fei.' After whispering to him, Chu Ying immediately ran out of the main hall with a blush on her face, causing her mother and aunt to shake their heads.

Liu Qingyu then said to him. "Fei'er, since my husband has approved of your relationship with Ying'er and Qing'er, how about we hold a simple ceremony for your wedding tomorrow morning? Moreover, Aunt Chen and Sister Qing Yi are also present right now, so we can do it right away."
Hearing that, Xu Ling'er tugged at her mother's sleeve and whispered. 'Mom, when are you going to marry Big Brother?'

'Sigh, I still have to wait for my divorce from your father to be finalized first, Ling'er.' Ru Xue replied with a soft sigh, and she felt jealousy in her heart. She was Zhang Fei's first woman, but he would marry other women first.

Xu Ling'er understood her mother's feelings very well, and she could see the jealousy in her eyes, so she then said. 'In that case, you should also marry Big Brother tomorrow morning, Mom. As for matters of marriage on earth, you can wait for divorce from my father.'
Even though they whispered like that, Liu Qingyu and Liu Hua could hear their conversation. They exchanged glances and nodded to each other.
Liu Qingyu then stated again. "Sister Ru Xue, you should also join in to marry Fei'er tomorrow morning."
"Huh?" Ru Xue looked at Liu Qingyu in surprise.

Zhang Chen then joined in. "That's right, Ru Xue. Although the wedding on this place is different from on Earth, it would be better if you also married him tomorrow morning; after all, you are Fei'er's first woman."

This time, it was the Liu Sisters who were surprised to hear that, mainly because Zhang Fei had not explained to them about his relationship with Ru Xue, so they didn't know that she was his first woman.
Zhang Chen then turned to her daughter-in-law. "You should also join them and marry him, Yi'er."
"No, Mother." Qing Yi shook her head; she knew very well that her son still hadn't forgiven her, so she didn't want to do it for now and would wait until he had forgiven her.

Zhang Fei did not say anything, and he indeed still had not forgiven Qing Yi for her decision two years ago. Even though she loved him so much in the past, her decision back then made him really disappointed in her.

"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding, and not persuading her further, she then turned to the Liu Sisters. "In that case, we will hold a simple ceremony for Fei'er's wedding with Ru Xue, Qing'er, and Ying'er tomorrow morning."
"Yay!" Xu Ling'er exclaimed happily upon hearing that. "Hehe, that's really good, mom! You'll be Big Brother's wife tomorrow!"
Ru Xue nodded smilingly while rubbing her only daughter's head; she truly felt happy to be married to Zhang Fei.
Zhang Chen suddenly asked Liu Hua. "Then how about you, Hua'er? Aren't you joining them tomorrow?"
Liu Hua shook her head and replied with a simple smile. "As long as Fei'er and I love each other, it doesn't matter to me whether we get married or not."

"You're wrong with that, Hua'er." Zhang Fei, who had been silent until now, finally spoke. "You are one of my women; if I marry them, then you must also marry me, because I want all of you to have the same status."
"Alright then, I'll marry you too tomorrow morning." Liu Hua answered without hesitation, and she was happy with Zhang Fei's words.
After they talked for a while, Zhang Chen, Qingyi, Ru Xue, and Xu Ling'er immediately returned to their room.
Liu Hua then asked Zhang Fei. "Anyway, where's your body double? How come I haven't seen him in two days?"

"Haha, my body double is going to Cheng Yu and Tang Rou's village, but they will be back soon." Zhang Fei then pondered for a moment before continuing. "Anyway, I plan to send my body double to the Yin-Yang Pavilion; what do you two think?"

"Hmm? If you want to send your body double to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, I'll ask my mother to write a letter of recommendation for you, that way you won't have to pass any tests to join there," Liu Qingyu said.

Liu Hua nodded in agreement with her big sister. "That's right, Fei'er. If your body double joins the Yin-Yang Pavilion, then you can get many dual cultivation partners, so your cultivation will also increase rapidly."

paragraphs: The next second, a woman with long red hair wearing a plain red dress landed in front of them, and she then spoke. "I haven't seen you in years, but you haven't changed at all, Liu Hua."

Liu Hua frowned at the appearance of the long red-haired woman; she really didn't expect that she would also appear to look for the Fire Yang Flower. 'Sigh, with her appearance, it will become even more difficult for us to get the Fire Yang Flower.'

Before Liu Hua could speak to her, a young man and young woman landed suddenly behind the long red-haired woman, and the young woman snorted disdainfully at the five naked Heavenly Sword Sect core disciples.
"You five quickly leave this place." The long red-haired woman said this to Gu Zhan and the others.

'Damn it! I didn't expect that woman to be Liu Hua!' Gu Zhan inwardly cursed as he got up from the ground. He then looked at Ye Lian, but she looked away coldly, so he and his fellow disciples immediately left the place to go to a resident's house to borrow clothes.
After they left, Ye Lian and the young woman behind the long red-haired woman glared at each other fiercely, but they didn't say anything.

Zhang Fei looked at the long red-haired woman with raised eyebrows, sensing something strange from her. 'Mei, scan the two women, and I can sense something unusual about the woman with long red hair.'
