'Zhang Lingxue? It's really unexpected that there is also a Zhang surname in this realm.' Zhang Fei was shocked after reading her data. 'Moreover, she has the Fire Phoenix Bloodline, and her cultivation is extremely high.'

[Hehe, you don't have to worry about her, Master. Her Fire Phoenix Bloodline is miniscule, I reckon she only got three drops of Fire Phoenix Bloodline.] Mei said as she giggled, but Zhang Fei still couldn't calm down, and he really wanted to leave Zhang Lingxue immediately. Then she continued.

[While both the Fire Phoenix and the Heavenly Fox are mythical beasts, Master, your position is far superior to hers because you are a complete Heavenly Fox. Moreover, you still have your demon charm and demon pheromone. Although I'm not sure if your demon charm will have any effect on her, she definitely won't be able to withstand your demon pheromone, so you really don't have to worry about her.]

Zhang Fei inwardly sighed in relief after he listened to Mei's explanation, then he secretly activated his demon charm to test her words and inwardly muttered. 'If she tries to do anything bad to Liu Hua, then I won't hesitate to use my demon pheromone on her. I'm not sure why Chang Wenjie dislikes Ye Lian, but she better not do anything bad to her.
"What are you doing in this place, Lingxue?" Liu Hua asked flatly.
Before Zhang Lingxue could answer her, the young man behind her had already shouted at Liu Hua. "Who do you think you are to dare to call my master by her name directly!?"
"It seems that your disciple has no etiquette, Lingxue." Liu Hua spoke in a mocking tone as she glared at the young man.
"You-"

"Stop it, Wenhao!" Zhang Lingxue immediately interrupted her disciple as she knew very well Liu Hua's character, the person who had always been her rival, before she was caught by Pang Hong. "Liu Hua, I'm glad to see you're back to being you again, but I'm really curious about how you managed to break free from Pang Hong's control."
'Liu Hua? So she is the one who used to be Master's rival in the past?' Chang Wenhao and Chang Wenjie were really surprised to learn of Liu Hua's identity.

"This is the will of fate, Lingxue." Liu Hua replied with a nonchalant shrug, but she inwardly said. 'Sigh, her current strength is far above mine, if the Fire Yang Flower falls into her hands, then I won't be able to snatch it away from her.'

Zhang Lingxue did not immediately speak again, as her eyes continued to observe Liu Hua, Zhang Fei, and the other women in turns. Before long, her expression was full of shock, and then she looked at Liu Hua in disbelief.
Liu Hua chuckled as she realized why her face had become so shocked. "As you might have guessed, Lingxue. He is Fei, and we are his wives, except for Yuan'er and Xuan'er yet."
Zhang Lingxue, Chang Wenjie, and Chang Wenhao looked at Zhang Fei in shock.
But in the next second, a glimmer of jealousy appeared in Chang Wenhao's eyes, especially after seeing the beauty of Liu Hua and the others.

Meanwhile, Chang Wenjie looked at Zhang Fei strangely, and her heart pounded violently due to the effect of his demon charm. 'What happened to me? Did I fall in love with him at first sight? But I have to admit that he is really handsome and dashing; no wonder those women are willing to share a husband with each other.'

But not Zhang Lingxue; as Mei had guessed before, she was completely unaffected by Zhang Fei's demon charm. But she continued to look at him strangely, and she could feel that her bloodline was trembling violently as he released his Heavenly Fox aura slightly. 'What the hell is this? Why did my bloodline suddenly tremble at the presence of that young man?
Before Zhang Lingxue sensed it, Zhang Fei had already retracted his Heavenly Fox aura because he didn't want to be targeted by strong people like her.

Mei laughed at Zhang Lingxue's reaction. [How is it, Master? The results match what I said earlier, right? Your demon charm may have no effect on her, but your Heavenly Fox aura and your demon pheromone will definitely have an effect on her.]
"It's time for us to climb the mountain, Hua'er." Zhang Fei said as he turned to leave, and he didn't say anything to Zhang Lingxue and the others.
"See you later, Lingxue." Liu Hua immediately followed Zhang Fei and the others.

'Damn it!' Chang Wenjie cursed inwardly, she was really annoyed that Zhang Fei didn't greet her. 'Just see what I'll do to you later, Fei! I'll certainly bring you to your knees and force you to submit to me!'
An evil smile appeared on Chang Wenhao's face, and his eyes continued to stare at Zhang Fei with jealousy and hostility. 'I'll definitely kill that scum, then I'll enjoy his women later.'
Suddenly, Zhang Lingxue rebuked him. "Get rid of those dirty thoughts of yours, Wenhao. I won't save you if Liu Hua intends to kill you later."
Chang Wenhao was taken aback by Zhang Lingxue's words, and he could only reply respectfully. "I understand, Master."

But in his heart, he was cursing Zhang Lingxue. And Chang Wenjie could only shake her head, as she was very familiar with her big brother's character. 'He is bound to be my toy, and if you dare to hurt him, then I will avenge your actions later.'

paragraphs: "Hah... Hah..." Chu Ying, Ye Lian, Chu Qing, Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, and Ru Xue were already panting heavily, even though they had only hiked for a while.

Zhang Fei's condition was not much different from theirs either. Although he had a very strong physique, this was his first time climbing a mountain, let alone a volcano in the cultivation world; he had never even climbed an ordinary mountain before.
Moreover, Blazing Volcano had a strange gravity; the more they climbed, the heavier the gravity would be.
[I detected something inside the volcano, Master. And it is the source of the strange gravity in this place.] Mei said as she kept trying to scan the inside of the volcano.
Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that. 'Can you see that thing, Mei? And can you find the location of that Fire Yang Flower?'

Mei didn't answer his question directly, and it wasn't until a few moments later that she spoke. [Hmm, this is really strange, Master. I sensed a sign of life from within the Blazing Volcano, but I couldn't detect what it was, and the location of the Fire Yang Flower was right next to it.]

Zhang Fei then opened his map, and he saw a green dot inside the Blazing Volcano, but strangely, he couldn't see the name or type of the creature. But he was surprised when he saw a red dot a bit far from his location, and he frowned as he saw the name that appeared from the red dot. 'Chang Wenhao? Wasn't he the man who was with Zhang Lingxue earlier? Why is he hostile toward me?
I don't even know him!'
[It seems that he is jealous of you, Master. Because you have many beautiful women as your wives.] Mei said with a chuckle.
Zhang Fei couldn't help but sigh heavily upon hearing that; he himself knew that there were three main things that could blind men's hearts and minds. Those three things are wealth, power, and women.
"What's the matter with you, Fei? Why are you sighing heavily like that?" Liu Hua asked in confusion, and the other women also turned to him.
"Do you know that man named Chang Wenhao, Hua'er?" Zhang Fei asked as he turned his head toward Liu Hua.

Liu Hua was taken aback by his question, she didn't remember mentioning Chang Wenhao's name in front of Zhang Fei before, but she was also aware that her man still had many other secrets that he kept to himself. "Chang Wenhao is the second young master of the Chang Clan in the Central Region, and the young woman beside him is his younger sister, Chang Wenjie.

As for the mature woman, she is Zhang Lingxue, she is the honorary elder of the Blazing Phoenix Sect. And now I just remember that you and Lingxue share the same surname, but she is a Sky Jade Realm native."

"Well, even in my realm, there are many people who have the same surname as me, but they are not my relatives." Zhang Fei said with a chuckle. His country's population was too large, and he also met many people with the same surname as him before. 'But that Zhang Lingxue really intrigues me; should I use my demon pheromone on her?'

[Hehe, you should use it on that woman, Master. Dual cultivating with her will accelerate your cultivation, and I believe you will also obtain beast essence from her, especially since she has fire phoenix bloodline.]

'Well, you're absolutely right, Mei. I need strength to fulfill my promise to Yue, and I will do everything for that.' Zhang Fei himself was really uneasy; he was afraid that he would not be able to fulfill his promise, and that would disappoint Hu Yue.

After climbing for quite a while, Liu Hua asked them to rest first, especially when she saw that the three earth women were so exhausted and that their Qi was also draining fast to protect themselves from the scorching heat.
'Are there items in the Items Shop they can use, Mei?' Zhang Fei couldn't bear to see them so exhausted.
[Hmm, master, you can give them the Qi Recovery Pill, and 1 pill costs 1 red jewel.]
However, a notification suddenly appeared in Zhang Fei's mind, causing him to smile in satisfaction.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 700 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 700 Red Jewels Sent To Inventory]
'Hey! My body double is really working hard.' Zhang Fei laughed in his heart. 'Anyway, have you counted the number of items in the storage rings of the core disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect?'
[Master, there aren't many valuable items in their storage ring, but they do have quite a number of jewels, especially that Gu Zhan.
'Oh? Show me.'
Red Jewels: 1,502,800
Green Jewels: 10,000
Blue Jewels: 5,000
'Not bad; I'll have a look at the shop later, but for now I have to buy some pills first.'
{You got Qi Recovery Pills x10}
{10 Red Jewels have been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei did not hesitate to purchase ten Qi recovery pills; he immediately swallowed one and divided the remaining nine pills among those women. "All of you swallow those Qi Recovery Pills; it will recover your Qi quickly."
Liu Hua was confused about where Zhang Fei got the pills, but she felt that now was not the right time to ask him, as they had to rush to the top of Blazing Mountain to pick up the Fire Yang Flower.
Without thinking, Liu Hua and the others immediately swallowed the Qi Recovery Pills, as they believed that Zhang Fei would never harm them.

After they swallowed the Qi Recovery Pills, Liu Hua and the women from the Sky Jade Realm immediately looked at Zhang Fei in complete shock. Unlike newbie cultivators like Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, and Ru Xue. They were experienced cultivators, so they knew that the effect of his Qi Recovery Pill was too great, and their Qi was immediately replenished after ingesting it.

"You guys don't need to be in such shock. I really don't want to lie to all of you, but I really can't tell you the origin of my pills. And most importantly, with the help of my pills, we can reach the peak of Blazing Volcano faster than them." Zhang Fei said with a smile, even though they were his women, he really didn't want to tell them about the existence of Mei and the system.

Liu Hua and the Wen twins looked at each other, and they nodded in agreement. Although they were really curious about the origin of the pill, they also didn't want to force Zhang Fei to tell them all his secrets, as it would also be dangerous for him if one of them fell into the hands of his enemies in the future.

Zhang Fei then stood up, as he said to them. "Anyway, I detected a living creature inside the Blazing Volcano, and the location of the Fire Yang Flower is right next to it, but I can't identify the creature."

Liu Hua and the others were even more shocked by Zhang Fei's words. They took a deep breath, then Liu Hua said. "If there really is a living creature inside the Blazing Volcano, then we have to be more careful. I've never heard of the creature before, so it's most likely that it hasn't lived inside the Blazing Volcano for long."
"En, let's continue our journey; we have to get ahead of them all." Zhang Fei said as he started climbing up the Blazing Volcano again, Liu Hua and the others immediately followed him.

Behind them, Zhang Lingxue was shocked to see that they had started climbing again. Moreover, she could tell that their depleted Qi had been replenished again. 'How did their qi fill up so fast? I've never heard of a pill or elixir that can recover Qi that fast before. Did it have something to do with that young man called Fei?
Sigh, that young man is too mysterious; even my Fire Phoenix Bloodline trembles before him.'
Not only she, but even Chang Wenhao and Chang Wenjie were shocked to see them, and Chang Wenjie inwardly said. 'Hehe, I'm getting more and more excited to make you submit to me, Fei!'

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Boitata
paragraphs: After climbing for about three hours, Zhang Fei and his women arrived at the top of Blazing Mountain, but they were not the first to arrive, as the Hai Twins arrived first.
But the Hai Twins were shocked when they saw Zhang Fei's group, because they didn't look exhausted at all, and their Qi wasn't depleted.
But alas, they didn't know that Zhang Fei's group had each swallowed three Qi Recovery Pills, so they didn't feel exhausted, as they could move freely using their Qi protection.
Zhang Fei glanced at them briefly, then he, Liu Hua, and the Wen twins walked to the edge of Blazing Volcano's crater.
Liu Hua then asked. "Are we going down now, Fei?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at her, and his eyes continued to stare into the crater.

With his Divine Senses, Zhang Fei's eyesight became five times sharper than Liu Hua's and the others, so he could see the figure of a humongous creature sleeping in the crater and the Fire Yang Flower, which was almost in full bloom not far from the creature.
"Fuck!" Zhang Fei cursed as soon as he recognized the creature. 'Scan the creature, Mei!'
Name: Boitata
Age: 1000+ Years Old
Race: Dragon Serpent
Rank: Divine Beast
Cultivation: 10 Star Heaven Realm
Element: Fire + Water
Core: Peak Rank Fire Water Core
Physique : Dragon Serpent Physique
Abilities: Fire Breath, Water Ball
Strong: Fire, Water
Weak: Earth, Lightning

Zhang Fei's expression became very ugly as soon as he read that; he didn't expect to meet a divine beast so soon. Moreover, the Boitata also had fire and water elements, and its size was humongous. 'This divine beast is troublesome; I'm afraid that it will become aggressive and attack them later.'
"Did you see anything, Fei'er?" Liu Hua asked curiously because Zhang Fei's expression suddenly became ugly.
However, Liu Hua was also in shock, as she couldn't see anything from the edge of the crater, but Zhang Fei could see that far.

"En." Zhang Fei nodded at her; he then took a deep breath and spoke quietly. "The creature in the crater is a divine beast, and its body size is humongous; moreover, it is also the possessor of fire and water elements."
"What!?" Liu Hua and the Wen Twins exclaimed in shock, but Zhang Fei hastily told them to shut their mouths, as he didn't want the Hai Twins to eavesdrop on them.

But their screams of shock were already heard by the Hai twins, and they looked at Zhang Fei's group with curiosity and suspicion, then Hai Dongyin spoke to her twins. "It seems that young man knows something that we don't know, Dongxin."

"En, I agree with you, Dongyin." Hai Dongxin said with a nod as her eyes continued to stare at Zhang Fei curiously. "It seems that their leader is that young man; even Liu Hua looks so obedient to him."
"Even though his cultivation is only at the 1 Star Foundation Realm, we really can't underestimate that young man." Hai Dongyin said as she also continued to observe Zhang Fei's group.
Hai Dongxin nodded in agreement. "We have to pay attention to that young man's movements; I have a hunch that he is the key to the seizure of the Fire Yang Flower."
"Sigh, we better recover our qi first." Hai Dongyin let out a low sigh and closed her eyes.
"Are you sure that the creature inside is a divine beast, Fei?" Liu Hua asked quietly. It was obvious that she was still shocked by Zhang Fei's words; even the Wen Twins were the same as her.

"It's true, Hua'er. That divine beast is a dragon serpent called Boitata." Zhang Fei then turned his head into the crater and spoke again. "Anyway, I want the three of you to protect Chu Qing and the others, and let me take care of the divine beast."
Liu Hua immediately grabbed Zhang Fei's hand. "But-"
"Trust me, okay?" Zhang Fei smiled at her, then caressed Liu Hua's cheek and softly spoke. "Did you forget how I got rid of Pang Hong back then?"

"Sigh, all right then, we will protect them." Liu Hua immediately agreed, as she still remembered that Zhang Fei could control the beasts back then, but this time the enemy was a divine beast, and it made her worry about his safety. "But you also have to be careful of Zhang Lingxue and the others, okay?"

"Don't worry, okay? Even though I'm not as strong as Zhang Lingxue, I still have my teleportation ability as well as everything else." Zhang Fei said with a smile, as he continued to caress Liu Hua's cheek. "Now let's take a break because the Fire Yang Flower hasn't fully bloomed yet."
Liu Hua and the Wen Twins nodded in agreement, then they returned to where Chu Qing and the others were to rest, while they waited for the Fire Yang Flower to fully bloom.

Before long, Zhang Lingxue's entourage and the Desolate Sect had also arrived at the peak of Blazing Volcano, and what was most surprising was that Gu Zhan and his fellow disciples also arrived shortly after them.
Gu Zhan kept glancing at Zhang Fei and Liu Hua with hostility, but they didn't dare to approach Zhang Fei's group, and they rested in a place some distance away from them.

Zhang Lingxue and her disciples also took a break not far from Zhang Fei's group; she then warned Chang Wenhao, who kept a lustful gaze on the women. "I'm warning you again, Wenhao. Stop what you're doing, and get your bad idea out of your mind. If Liu Hua knows about your bad idea, then she will kill you, and I won't save you from her."

"Yes, Master." Chang Wenhao replied quietly, then lowered his head as he inwardly cursed. 'Tsk, damn woman! Who do you think you are to dare to rule over me? I will definitely report you to my father later.'

Chang Wenji, who was affected by the effects of his Demon Charm, continued to stare restlessly at Zhang Fei, who was meditating, and she tried hard to restrain herself from the strong urge rising from within her. 'What really happened to me? Why is my inner urge to get closer to him getting stronger? He is indeed very handsome and dashing, but he is too weak.
People will surely laugh at me if I take the first step to approaching a weak man like him.'
After she felt restless for a while, Chang Wenji then stood up from her seat and immediately walked towards Zhang Fei.

Zhang Lingxue raised her eyebrows at Chang Wenjie's strange behavior. She didn't know what her disciple wanted to do with Zhang Fei's group, but she knew that she wouldn't do anything bad like her big brother.
Chang Wenhao frowned at his little sister's behavior. He wanted to follow Chang Wenjie, but Zhang Lingxue immediately stopped him by glaring at him, which made him grit his teeth in anger.
Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes when Chang Wenjie arrived in front of him, and he looked at her as he laughed inwardly, because the effect of the demon charm was very strong on her.
Liu Hua and the other women also opened their eyes, and they were surprised by Chang Wenjie's arrival. But the next second, their eyes immediately widened at her action.
Without saying anything, Chang Wenjie sat in front of Zhang Fei and kissed his lips directly.
Zhang Fei laughed contentedly in his heart. He happily returned Chang Wenjie's kiss, and they kissed passionately.
Zhang Lingxue and Chang Wenhao's eyes widened at her actions, and their mouths fell open. They were truly shocked to see Chang Wenjie take the first step to kiss Zhang Fei.

After kissing passionately for quite a while, Chang Wenjie parted their lips, then looked at Zhang Fei with hazy eyes and spoke with a bashful expression. "It was my first kiss, so you have to be responsible for me."
-- To Be Continued --

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Fire Yang Flower Bloom
paragraphs: Chang Wenji said with a bashful expression. "It was my first kiss, so you have to be responsible to me."

"Huh?" Zhang Fei then spoke with an innocent look. "Miss, you kissed me first, so I returned the favor, and now you expect me to be responsible to you? Besides, I don't even know you, and vice versa."

"I don't care! Anyway, you must be responsible to me!" Chang Wenjie said with a frown, and then she glanced at Liu Hua and the others. "You should also leave them and come with me to the Central Region!"
Liu Hua and the others darkened at her words, and Chu Qing immediately shouted angrily at Chang Wenji. "You shameless woman! You kissed Fei yourself, and you are now asking him to leave us!"
"Humph! So what!?" Cang Wenjie snorted at Chu Qing. "All of you are just weak women; if he comes with me to the Central Region, then my Chang Clan can help him become stronger quickly!"
Hearing that, Ye Lian took out his sword. She herself had disliked Chang Wenjie for a long time. But before he could do anything, they heard Zhang Fei shouting.
"Enough!" Zhang Fei shouted at Chang Wenji as he used his Demon Eyes for a brief moment.
Even if it was only for a brief moment, it was enough to make Chang Wenjie feel extreme fear; she broke out in cold sweat, and her body trembled violently. "You-!"
"You what?" Zhang Fei looked at her coldly and snapped at Chang Wenjie in a rising tone. "I know that your Chang Clan is strong, but I will never allow anyone to insult and demean my women!"

"Hey, you damn brat!" Chang Wenhao shouted from afar, then he dashed towards Zhang Fei. "Who do you think you are to dare to yell at my little sister? My Chang Clan can destroy your clans like ants! You guys-!"
Howeve, Chang Wenhao hadn't finished speaking yet; a dagger was already stuck to his neck, and he froze at it. 'Shit! She's really fast!'

Chang Wenjie was horrified to see that. She opened her mouth to say something, but the fear that Zhang Fei's Demon Eyes instilled in her made her unable to speak, and her body trembled even more violently.

Liu Hua stood behind Chang Wenhao, and she pressed her dagger against his neck, causing blood to drip from his neck, as she coldly said. "You are just an ignorant little brat who can only rely on your clan name to suppress others. Unfortunately, you are wrong if you think that I dare not kill you just because you are a member of the Chang Clan."
Chang Wenhao was speechless, and he felt a chill down his spine. Moreover, he could sense that Liu Hua was not joking with her words, as he also felt blood dripping from his neck.

Seeing the commotion between them, Gu Zhan and the Heavenly Sect disciples smiled while laughing in their hearts, especially after they heard about the Chang Clan and the Central Region from Chang Wenhao's mouth.

'Sigh, this is really troublesome; they don't know the Liu Clan's true strength. I have to stop them, or else things will get messy in the future.' Zhang Lingxue inwardly sighed; she didn't expect that Chang Wenjie would insult them, plus Chang Wenhao also brought his clan name; then she stood up and walked over to Liu Hua. "Please spare him, Liu Hua.
He is just an ignorant little brat, and it will tarnish your reputation if you kill a little brat like him."
"Hey, did you forget that I never cared about my reputation, Lingxue?" Liu Hua said as she pressed her dagger harder against Chang Wenhao's neck, and more blood dripped from his neck.
'Shit!' Chang Wenhao could only curse in his heart.
"I know, but-"
But suddenly Zhang Fei spoke. "Hua'er, just let him go; there's no point in killing a coward who can only rely on his clan name. Moreover, the Fire Yang Flower will soon be in full bloom."

Liu Hua and Zhang Lingxue looked at Zhang Fei with raised eyebrows; they didn't understand how he could tell that the Fire Yang Flower was about to fully bloom soon. Before they could ask him, a pillar of fire shot up into the sky from within the crater.

All of them turned towards the pillar of fire, then Liu Hua and Zhang Lingxue turned to see Zhang Fei again. They were really shocked because his words were so accurate; even they themselves couldn't guess as accurately as him.
"I'll only spare you this once, but if it happens again, then I'll kill you straight away." Liu Hua said as she put away her dagger, and she then returned to Zhang Fei's side.
Zhang Lingxue let out a sigh of relief and used her qi to lift Chang Wenjie to her feet, and she led them to the edge of the crater.

Gu Zhan and the Heavenly Sword Sect disciples also rushed to the edge of the crater. The Desolate Sect disciples also did the same. As for the Hai twins, they still didn't move from their seats, and they seemed to be waiting for Zhang Fei's next move.
Chang Wenjie continued to stare at Zhang Fei with mixed feelings; she felt restless, annoyed, angry, and scared.
Chang Wenhao was also the same; he kept glancing at Zhang Fei and Liu Hua in turn, and his eyes were full of hatred and hostility.

Zhang Lingxue couldn't help but shake her head seeing them like that, but then she also glanced at Zhang Fei's group, and she raised her eyebrows in confusion, because they still looked so relaxed. 'Is there something that I missed?'

Zhang Fei ignored their gazes; he then whispered to Liu Hua and the others very quietly. "You quickly take them away from this place, Hua'er. The divine beast has awakened from its slumber, and it is angry with our presence."
"But Fei-!"
"Entrust everything to Fei, Qing'er." Liu Hua immediately interrupted Chu Qing, and then she asked the women to follow her.
The women turned to Zhang Fei, and he nodded to them with a confident smile. "I'll catch up with you guys soon."
"Be careful, Fei!" Chu Qing and the others said in unison, and then they followed Liu Hua and the Wen twins down the Blazing Volcano.
Even though the women did nothing, the trip to the top of Blazing Volcano had actually strengthened their bodies, thanks to the high gravity at the top.

Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins were taken aback by their actions, but they also wondered in their hearts because Zhang Fei looked so calm and relaxed, and they were thinking the same thing. 'What exactly is that young man thinking? What does he really know that we don't? And why did he tell Liu Hua and the others to come down first?'

Heavenly Sword Sect disciples and Chang Wenhao smiled upon seeing Zhang Fei alone, and they said the same in their hearts. 'Hehe, without Liu Hua by his side, I can definitely kill that damn brat easily.'

Seeing Zhang Fei alone, Chang Wenji became worried about him because she knew for sure that her big brother would definitely do something to him, plus those Heavenly Sword Sect disciples, and she inwardly said so. 'Please be safe, Fei.'
"Let's pick the Fire Yang Flower now!" Gu Zhan said to his fellow disciples, and they immediately jumped into the crater, the Desolate Sect disciples following behind them.
"We also have to go down to the crater." As Zhang Lingxue enveloped Chang Wenji and Chang Wenhao in her qi, they leapt into the crater.
Zhang Fei's lips curled up as he noticed the Hai twins still sitting and waiting for him; he then used his teleportation ability to vanish from before them.
"Damn it!" The Hai Twins cursed in shock and mobilized their Qi, and they jumped into the crater directly.

However, in the next second, Zhang Fei reappeared some distance away from his previous location and sat leisurely on top of a big tree branch, as he said with a chuckle. "Now we just have to wait for the Yin-Yang Pavilion group to arrive and let them take on that Boitata first. After they get beaten up by it, only then will I snatch that Fire Yang Flower from them."
Mei giggled. [You are really as cunning as a fox, Master.]
-- To Be Continued --

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Shen Yu
paragraphs: Some time later, the members of the Yin-Yang Pavilion arrived at the peak of Blazing Volcano, and Zhang Fei was only observing them from afar, or rather, he was only paying attention to Shen Yu, the Sea Serpent.
[Do you want to prevent that woman from descending into the crater, Master?] Mei asked in a teasing tone, as she knew Zhang Fei's thoughts about Shen Yu.

Zhang Fei laughed softly, and he scratched the back of his head. He did intend to prevent Shen Yu from descending into the crater, as he did not want her to be hurt by the Boitata. 'I don't want anything to happen to her, Mei.'
"Tsk, we're late; they've gone down to the crater first." One of the Yin-Yang Pavilion's male disciples said.
Then another male disciple complained. "It's all your and Ning Xiang's fault, Luo Hai!"
They looked at the male disciple with a frown, then Ning Xiang refuted him. "Why are you blaming us, Xie Gang? It's because you've been dual cultivating with Du Yuan for too long!"
"You-"
"Enough!" Shen Yu finally spoke up. "You guys stop blaming each other and quickly enter the crater!"
"Humph!" Ning Xiang and Xie Gang snorted at each other, then they jumped down into the crater with their respective dual cultivation partners.

Shen Yu shook her head, then she enveloped her body with her Qi, but just as she was about to jump down into the crater, she suddenly felt a strong pressure on her bloodline, and the pressure forced her to kneel down with one foot on the ground. 'What is going on? Why does my bloodline feel pressured?'
"You don't need to be confused, Shen Yu."

Hearing that, Shen Yu turned her head to the side, and she saw Zhang Fei walking leisurely towards her. She then raised her eyebrows, because she could feel that his cultivation was only at 1 Star Foundation Realm, yet the aura emitting from his body suppressed her bloodline. 'Is he a beast with a bloodline higher and stronger than mine?'

As he arrived in front of her, Zhang Fei retracted his Heavenly Fox aura and stretched out his hand to her, as he sincerely said. "I'm really sorry, Shen Yu. But I was forced to do this to prevent you from descending into the crater, because I really don't want to see you hurt."

Shen Yu was stunned by Zhang Fei's words, but she could sense that he was speaking sincerely, and she did not feel any malicious intent from him either. Then she took his hand and rose from the ground, as she asked. "What do you mean by that? And how do you know my name?"

"I also know that you are a sea serpent, Shen Yu." She froze hearing that, because no one had ever known that she was a beast, but before she could ask him, Zhang Fei had spoken again. "I don't know about your relationship with the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but I won't let you risk your life for them, because there is a beast much stronger than you in the crater."
"What!? Is that true?" Shen Yu exclaimed as she looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief, then she suspiciously asked. "If there really is a powerful beast in the crater, then why don't you stop them?"

"Because their lives are none of my business." Zhang Fei shrugged nonchalantly, then he looked at Shen Yu and confessed bluntly. "But you are different from them; I want you to be my partner, so I don't want to see you get hurt."
Shen Yu was stunned when she heard Zhang Fei's words, as she was unable to respond. She didn't even know him, and this was also their first meeting, but he immediately confessed to her like that.

He caressed her cheek with his hand; strangely, Shen Yu did not intend to push his hand away. He then seriously spoke. "Anyway, my name is Zhang Fei. I really want you to be my partner, and we will grow stronger together."
Shen Yu continued to be silent, and she looked at Zhang Fei with wide eyes, as she didn't know what to say to him.
*Boom!*
Suddenly, there was a loud explosion from inside the crater, then Zhang Fei grabbed Shen Yu and carried her away from the edge of the crater using his teleportation ability.
Shen Yu finally asked. "Actually, what kind of beast is in the crater, Zhang Fei?"
"Dragon Serpent Boitata is a divine beast, and its cultivation is in the 10 Star Heaven Realm." Zhang Fei replied as his eyes focused on the crater.
Shen Yu was stunned for a moment, then she exclaimed in shock. "Are you joking with me, Zhang Fe?"
Zhang Fei answered her by shaking his head. "I'm not joking with you; Boitata is truly a divine beast."
Inside the crater
Gu Zhan crawled backwards in fear, as his four fellow disciples were turned to ashes by Boitata's fire breath, and the Desolate Sect disciples also suffered the same fate as them.

"Damn it!" Zhang Lingxue cursed as she shielded the terrified Chang Wenjie and Cheng Wenhao behind her. "How can there be a Divine Beast in this place? Moreover, its cultivation is in the 10 Star Heaven Realm."
But suddenly they smelled urine, and they turned to Chen Wenhao, who wet his pants. Seeing that, Zhang Lingxue shook her head, and Chang Wenjie exclaimed in disdain. "You are so disgusting, brother!"

Chang Wenhao paid no heed to his little sister's words, as he continued to stare at the humongous snake in front of him with his body shaking violently. Moreover, the figure of the snake was truly terrifying; its body was filled with many eyes.
On the other side, the Hai twins' expressions were really ugly, and they also felt the horror of Boitata's presence. They then looked around looking for Zhang Fei, but they couldn't find him.

"That young man has tricked us, Dongxin. He must have known that this Divine Beast resided in this crater, but he deliberately didn't tell us about it." Hai Dongyin said this as she gritted her teeth.

"Yes, but we can't blame him either, since we're all competing for the Fire Yang Flower." Hai Dongxin said with a nod, as her eyes continued to stare at Boitata with worry and high vigilance, as she occasionally glanced at the Fire Yang Flower, which was surrounded by Boitata. "Now we have to figure out how to pick that flower."

"I think we should back off, Dongxin." Hai Dongyin spoke seriously. Although she really wanted to get the Fire Yang Flower, but she felt that the flower was not worth her life, especially since Boitata was much stronger than them.
Hai Dongxin was silent and thought for a while, then she sighed and spoke. "You're right, we better back off, Dongyin."
But just as they were about to retreat, suddenly a large rock fell on Boitata's head, and four people rolled down from above.
It enraged the Boitata, and it spit fire from its big mouth. "Hiss~ I will definitely kill all of you!"
-- To Be Continued --

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Boitata Enrage
paragraphs: The Boitata's large mouth spits fire. "Hiss~ I will definitely kill all of you!"
*Crackles*
"Shit!" Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins immediately released their qi at the same time.
Seeing that, the four Yin-Yang Pavilion disciples who had just fallen from above also took out several artifacts, and four black and white Qi shields appeared in front of them.
*Cracks*

However, the four shields began to crack, and they became panicked by their situation. But unexpectedly, the next moment, the male disciples took out a small jade from their storage ring and broke it, and they disappeared from the crater directly, leaving the two women.
"Bastard!" Ning Xiang cursed angrily upon seeing them disappear, and then Ning Xiang and Du Yuan also took their jade.

But at the same time, the Boitata swung its big tail at all of them. Zhang Lingxue immediately took out her red sword and swung it towards its tail, and a red qi shaped like a phoenix shot out from her sword.
The Hai twins also took out their weapons. Hai Dongyin used a large blue bow and shot three arrows of blue qi towards Boitata's tail.
As for Hai Dongxin, she used two small spears and thrust them towards Boitata's tail, and two blue Qis shot towards its tail.
*Bang... Bang... Bang...*

But the female disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion were unlucky; before they could break the jade in their hands, their black and white shields shattered, sending them flying backwards far away and their jade slipping from their hands.
Seeing that, the Hai twins jumped in front of them to protect them, and Hai Dongyin asked. "Are you two okay?"
"Cough... I'm fine, seniors." Ning Xiang replied as she wiped the blood that was dripping from her mouth.
Du Yuan also wiped the blood from her mouth, then replied as she endured the pain in her hand from being burned by the fire of Boitata. "Seniors, i'm fine, thank you."
*Crackles*
Being hit by the attacks from Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins, the Boitata became more and more enraged, and its flames grew stronger.

"You two quickly get out of this crater; I won't be able to hold this divine beast any longer." Zhang Lingxue yelled at her two disciples. Even though she has Fire Phoenix Bloodline, her bloodline is meaningless in front of a complete divine beast like Boitata, and its cultivation is far beyond her reach. Plus, she also had to continue to protect her two disciples, and it drained her Qi quickly.
"But, Master-"
"Go!" Zhang Lingxue interrupted Chang Wenjie.
Chang Wenjie gritted her teeth and grabbed the still-frightened Chang Wenhao by the collar, then she carried him away from the crater.
The Hai twins also told Ning Xiang and Du Yuan to come out of the crater, they nodded in agreement and moved towards the surface.
Seeing that, the Boitata increased its firepower again, and it continued swinging its tail at them.
Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins continued to dodge and attack Boitata's tail while they waited for their four juniors to leave the crater.
*Crackles*
"Dodge!" Hai Dongyin called out to her twin sisters as she also jumped far away to dodge Boitata's head strike at them.

Hai Dongxin also jumped far away, but she was a little late, and Boitata's big tail slammed into her body. She was slammed into the crater wall with a loud bang and spat out a mouthful of blood before she fell to the ground. "Damn it! My bones feel crushed by its attack."
"Dongxin!" Hai Dongyun shouted in shock as Boitata's huge tail swung towards Hai Dongxin again, then she shot three Qi arrows towards its head.
*Swish*
However, her attacks have no effect on Boitata because her cultivation is far below its and it has a thick skin.
*Bam*
Luckily for Hai Dongxin, before Boitata's tail slammed into her, Zhang Lingxue had already flown to her rescue, and they landed beside Hai Dongyin.
Hai Dongxin expressed gratitude to Zhang Lingxue. "Cough... Thank you, Lingxue."
"Don't mind it." Zhang Linxue replied, as she panted heavily, then she asked the Hai twins. "Do you two still want to pick that Fire Yang Flower?"

"We can't do it, Lingxue. This damn snake is too big and fast." Hai Dongyin replied with a shake of her head and looked up towards the outside of the crater. "Looks like they're out; it's time for us to leave this place."
"True, we better leave this crater now. Otherwise, we'll run out of qi soon." Zhang Lingxue nodded in agreement, and the three of them immediately flew out of the crater.
But unexpectedly, the Boitata followed them, even though its body was huge, but it could move really fast.
"Shit!" Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins cursed, and they flew towards the exit even faster.

While it was chasing Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins, Zhang Fei suddenly appeared beside the Fire Yang Flower along with Shen Yu, and he smiled with satisfaction at the sight of the Boitata, who continued to creep up after the three women.
"You really are cunning, Zhang Fei." Shen Yu said with a chuckle; she really didn't expect that he had such an extraordinary movement technique, and he could even carry her into the crater instantly.

"Hey, since I'm much weaker than them, I have to use my brain to outwit them." Zhang Fei replied as he crouched down; he then plucked the Fire Yang Flower and stored it in his inventory because Mei told him that the effect of the flower would not decrease if he kept it in his inventory, and then he asked Shen Yu. "So what's your decision? Are you willing to be my woman?"

"I'm sorry, but I'm not ready to be anyone's partner right now." Shen Yu replied with a shake of her head, and Zhang Fei looked disappointed to hear her answer, so she said it again. "Sorry that I have to disappoint you, but if we are indeed destined to be a couple, then we will definitely become a couple in the future."
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed heavily. Although he could force her to be his woman, he really didn't want to do that to Shen Yu. "En, I understand, and I will definitely see you again in the future."

"En, you can visit me whenever you want in the Southern Region; I live in Southern River City, close to the Yin-Yang Pavilion." Shen Yu said with a sweet smile, relieved that Zhang Fei did not try to force her to be his woman, even though he could.

Zhang Fei and Shen Yu looked up as they heard an extremely loud explosion from the surface, and he said with a grin. "I've already obtained the Fire Yang Flower, but there's still one more thing I have to do."
"What do you want to do, Zhang Fei?" Shenyu asked curiously.
Zhang Fei only replied with a chuckle, then he grabbed Shen Yu's hand and carried her out of the crater with his teleportation.
After they disappeared, a man appeared from a gap; he was lucky enough to survive Boitata's previous attack because he found a gap in the crater wall before its tail almost slammed into him.
The man was none other than Gu Zhan, and he said it while gritting his teeth in anger. "Damn it! The Fire Yang Flower fell into that damn brat's hands."

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Two Choices
paragraphs: "Master!" Chang Wenji shouted from a distance as she saw Zhang Lingxue and the Hai Twins being sent flying far away after Boitata's tail slammed into their bodies.
*Bam*
Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins slammed into the ground really hard; they spat out a lot of blood from their mouths, and their bodies went numb because Boitata's attack was so powerful.
"Cough... Cough..." Zhang Lingxue coughed hard, and she lay helplessly on the ground as she shouted at Chang Wenjie. "Leave this place quickly, Wenjie!"
Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins looked at Boitata in horror, even though they were experienced cultivators. They felt a tremendous fear towards it, especially since their Qi had been depleted.

"Hiss~ Do you think I'll let them go?" The Boitata said disdainfully, and the humongous snake then opened its mouth wide, and two huge fireballs shot towards Chang Wenjie, Chang Wenhao, Ning Xiang, and Du Yuan.
"Damn it!" Zhang Lingxue then mustered up the last of her Qi; with great difficulty, she swung her red sword, and a fire phoenix shot towards one of the fireballs.
The Hai twins were the same; they used up their last qi, and a bunch of blue qi shot towards the other fireball.
*Bam... Bam...*
Unfortunately, their attacks had no effect on them, and the two fireballs continued to shoot towards Chang Wenji and the others at a rapid pace.
"Damn it!" Chang Wenhao gritted his teeth, but he gave an evil grin, then he pushed Chang Wenjie and the two women towards the two fireballs using his Qi, and he immediately flew away.

"Bastard!" Chang Wenji was cursed with anger; she was really shocked that her brother sacrificed herself to save himself. But it was too late; the fireball was too close to her, and she could only lament in her heart that she had brought her brother out of the crater earlier.
Ning Xiang and Du Yuan were also the same as her; they had already closed their eyes in resignation, as they already had no chance to dodge the fireball.

Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins were also shocked by Chang Wenhao's actions; they really didn't expect that he would sacrifice the three women for his own safety, but they were also powerless to save them, as their Qi had been completely depleted.

Zhang Lingxue was grieved to see Chang Wenjie darting towards the fireball, and she couldn't help but scream, full of anger and regret. "Chang Wenhao! You bastard! If I survive today, I will definitely kill you with my own hands!"
*Bam... Bam...*

The two fireballs exploded as soon as they hit the ground, and the explosion produced a very loud bang, and the entire Blazing Volcano shook violently; the shock was felt all the way to Blazing Foothills Village.
At a place far away from the peak, Liu Hua and the others tried to stabilize themselves, but Chu Qing and the newbies fell to the ground.
"What exactly happened up there, Aunt Hua?" Chu Qing anxiously asked as she rubbed her buttocks.

Liu Hua didn't immediately answer her question, and she exerted her senses toward the peak. Unfortunately, the Blazing Volcano's strangeness prevented her senses from reaching the peak, so she answered. "I can't see what's going on up there, but I think Lingxue and the others are fighting the Divine Beast."
"Then what about Big Brother, Aunt Hua?" Zhang Lin also asked anxiously and clasped her hands tightly.

"I don't know, Lin'er." Liu Hua replied with a shake of her head, then she turned to them. "You guys take it easy; Fei'er's not a fool; I'm sure that nothing happened to him, and he won't act recklessly either."
"En, that's right." Qing Yi nodded in agreement. "Fei'er will definitely be fine, because he is really smart, and he always acts cautiously."
But even so, Qing Yi was still worried about her son's safety. 'Please stay safe, Fei'er.'
Blazing Volcano Peak
"Hiss~ They're dead now, and now it's you guys' turn." The boitata said this as its forked tongue protruded further and its fiery eyes locked on Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins.
*Chuckles*

Suddenly, a male chuckle was heard not far from them. Zhang Lingxue and the Hai twins looked in the direction the voice came from. They were shocked and relieved when they saw Chang Wenjie, Ning Xiang, and Du Yuan survive the Boitata fireballs.
Zhang Lingxue, on the other hand, was wondering in her heart. 'How could he save them from those fireballs at such close range?'

Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin glanced at each other, and they smiled bitterly. Although they still felt irritated at being tricked by Zhang Fei, they also felt grateful because he saved the three women.
"Thank you for saving me, Fei." Chang Wenjie expressed gratitude as she calmed herself down.
Ning Xiang and Du Yuan also expressed gratitude. "Thank you for saving us, Young Master."

"You guys don't need to thank me; I just feel it would be a waste if I let three beauties die." Zhang Fei said with a smile, and then he asked Shen Yu. "Help me bring those three helpless women here, and I will face Boitata by myself."
"Don't do it, Fei!" Chang Wenjie exclaimed as she grabbed Zhang Fei's hand tightly. "That snake is really strong; even Master and the Hai Twins are not its opponents."
"Hey, just because they aren't its equal doesn't mean I'm not its adversary." As he removed Chang Wenjie's hand from his, Zhang Fei jumped from the tree and strolled leisurely toward Boitata.
Boitata looked at him furiously, then it shot several small fireballs from its mouth at him. With his sharp senses and his teleportation, Zhang Fei was able to dodge all the fireballs very easily.
*Bam... Bam... Bam...*
At the same time, Shen Yu moved to help Zhang Lingxue and the Hai Twins, and she brought them to Chai Wenjie's side.
Their eyes widened, when they saw that Zhang Fei wasn't hurt in the slightest by the Boitata's attack, and they rubbed their eyes to convince themselves that they didn't see it wrong.

"Incredible! Although his cultivation is only at the 1 Star Foundation Realm, his movement technique is extraordinary, and he can use it efficiently." Zhang Lingxue muttered in admiration, and the Hai Twins nodded in agreement with her words.
As he showed the Fire Yang Flower to the Boitata, Zhang Fei said. "Hey, stupid snake, look at this."
"Hiss~ How dare you take my treasure!" Boitata shouted in rage, then it swung its huge tail quickly towards Zhang Fei.
*Bam... Bam...*

However, Zhang Fei dodged its tail attack using his teleportation, and he stored the Fire Yang Flower into his inventory again. He then reappeared a bit far in front of the Boitata, and he said. "I give you two choices; submit to me or die."

chapters.title: Chapter 92: First Beast Contract
paragraphs: Zhang Fei spoke to Boitata. "I give you two choices: submit to me or die."
Zhang Lingxue and the other women were dumbfounded when they heard Zhang Fei's words. They didn't know where his confidence came from, but for some reason they didn't doubt his words.

"Hiss~ Hahaha." Boitata laughed out loud at his words, and all eyes on its body stared at Zang Fei with disdain, then it mocked him. "Do you think you can kill me with your cultivation in the 1 Star Foundation Realm, brat? You're really good at boasting; even that woman with a 9 Star Earth Realm cultivation can't hurt me."
"Heh," Zhang Fei snorted at the Boitata as he transformed into a half-fox, then released his Heavenly Fox aura to suppress it, and his eyes turned blood red at the same time.

This was Zhang Fei's first time trying to combine the abilities of his two bloodlines, and obviously, his experiment was successful; the auras of his Heavenly Fox as well as his Demon Eyes instantly suppressed Boitata.
Boitata immediately slumped to the ground, all eyes on it as its body trembled violently; it could only stare at Zhang Fei in fear.

"What the hell? He's a demihuman?" Zhang Lingxue and the other women exclaimed in shock; they were really shocked to see Zhang Fei's half-fox form, and they were even more shocked to see Boitata so frightened of him.

Only Shen Yu was not shocked to see Zhang Fei's half-fox form, and she was only slightly surprised because he was a fox beast, but she was unable to recognize the type of his fox race. 'I've never met a fox beast whose aura was as terrifying as his before; even the auras of the moon foxes weren't as scary as his. If my assumption is correct, he must be a mythical fox beast.
Zhang Fei walked in front of the boitata's head, jumped on its mouth, and then stomped his feet hard, as he said evilly. "Now tell me; do you think I can kill you now?"
Boitata was already terrified by his Heavenly Fox aura, as well as the fear effect of his Demon Eyes, which made her truly fearful of Zhang Fei.
"Now choose; submit to me or die." Zhang Fei said that as he released his killing intent, it was Liu Hua and the Wen Twins who taught him how to use his killing intent to intimidate his enemies.

Boitata continued to stare at Zhang Fei in horror, even though it had the pride of being a divine beast but was also aware that Zhang Fei was a mythical rank fox beast. In the end, it resignedly said. "Hiss~ I will submit to you, Master."
"Great!" Zhang Fei then pressed his forehead against Boitata's head. 'Do it, Mei.'
[Aye sir~]

After Mei answered, the next second, a white light appeared on their foreheads, and the light was so bright that it blinded them. A few minutes later, the white light disappeared, and a notification suddenly popped into Zhang Fei's mind.
[Ding]
[Hidden Quest: Taming a Divine Beast]
[Status: Completed]
[Rewards: Beast Function Unlocked, Beast Space Unlocked]

Zhang Fei was surprised by the notification, because all this time he had never gotten any other quest other than his daily quest, and the reward made him wonder in his heart. 'Hmm? Beast Function? Beast Space?'
[Soul Connect: By using it, the Master can increase his personal power by 50% of the Beast's power, and vice versa.]
[Mind Connect: The Master can see and hear what beasts see and hear, and both can communicate with each other from great distances.]
[Beast Space: A special space for beasts, if the beasts stay in it, they can recover their qi quickly, and all the wounds they suffered during battle can also heal very quickly.]

Mei then said so excitedly. [Both are really good for you, Master. With Soul Connect, you can use 50% of Boitata's power; that way, you can face cultivators in the 10 Star Core Realm or maybe the 1 Star Soul Realm easily.]
'En, they were indeed useful.' Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, then he jumped down from above the Boitata's mouth, and asked. "Can you turn yourself into a human?"
"Not yet, Master. In order to transform into a human, I must first break through to the Sovereign Realm." Boitata answered with a shake of its head.
Zhang Fei sighed. "Rest in my beast space first."
After Zhang Fei said that, he immediately sent the Boitata into his Beast Space and returned to his human form, then he walked over to the women.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Return
paragraphs: Zhang Fei walked down the blazing volcano together with Zhang Lingxue and Chang Wenjie. As for the Hai twins, they decided to return to their sect using the returning jade.
"So where's your male disciple? Why isn't he with the two of you?" Zhang Fei casually asked.

The two women's expressions turned ugly as soon as Zhang Fei asked about Chang Wenhao; Chang Wenjie looked really angry hearing her brother's name, and Zhang Lingxue answered with a heavy sigh. "He ran away after pushing Wenjie and the two women towards the Divine Beast's fireballs, but I will definitely hunt him down and kill him with my own hands."
"Master-"

"Your master is right, Wenjie." Zhang Fei interrupted Chang Wenjie, who was about to speak. "A person who intends to sacrifice his family for his own safety doesn't deserve to live, if you let him live now, then one day he will definitely do even more dangerous things to you and the rest of your family."
Chang Wenjie fell silent, and she lowered her face sadly. She knew that Zhang Fei's words were true, but Chang Wenhao was her brother after all.

Zhang Lingxue turned to Chang Wenjie, she realized that her disciple was sad, but she would not change her decision about Chang Wenhao. Then she turned to Zhang Fei and asked. "Are you a member of my Zhang Clan? But I have never heard of your name before in my clan, and moreover, you are a demi-human."
Hearing that, Chang Wenjie also immediately looked at Zhang Fei curiously, and she was really curious about his beast race identity.

Zhang Fei turned to her, and he laughed softly before answering her question. "My surname is Zhang, but I am not from your Zhang Clan, Lingxue. Because I come from a different place, I can't explain it to you. And you are also wrong about one thing; I am not a demi-human, but I am an ordinary human with bloodline inheritance like you."
"How did you know that I obtained a bloodline inheritance?" Zhang Lingxue asked in shock; even Liu Hua didn't know about it because she got her bloodline after she fell into Pang Hong's hands.

"Three drops of Fire Phoenix Bloodline, right?" Zhang Lingxue was even more shocked to hear that, but Chang Wenjie had a different reaction, she seemed to be admiring Zhang Fei, then he continued. "You don't need to be shocked and panicked; everyone has their own secrets."

Zhang Lingxue continued to stare at him in shock, suspicion, and disbelief. But, in the end, she couldn't force him to say anything to her because their situation had changed and he was now stronger than her thanks to the Divine Beast's protection. 'Is there a Zhang Clan somewhere else? But I really never knew that.
What's more, this Zhang Fei is too mysterious; he can even subdue the Divine Beast so easily.'

Along the way, Zhang Lingxue kept thinking a lot about Zhang Fei; you could say this was the first time she felt something unusual towards the opposite sex. As the old saying goes, starting with curiosity, another seed can grow in a person's heart towards the opposite sex.

Chang Wenjie herself also kept glancing at Zhang Fei, and he was aware of it, but he chose to pretend he didn't notice. Even though Chang Wenjie was really beautiful and she also came from the strongest clan, her first impression was really bad for him.
After walking for a while, they finally arrived at Blazing Foothills Village, where, unexpectedly, Liu Hua and his other women were waiting for him at the entrance.
"Fei!"
"Big Brother!"
Chu Qing and Zhang Lin immediately shouted and ran towards Zhang Fei, then they jumped into his arms, as they sobbed.
Zhang Fei smiled as he hugged them and spoke as he rubbed their backs. "Why are you both crying? I came back safely, and nothing happened to me."
"I was really worried about you, Fei, Big Brother." Zhang Lin and Chu Qing said this in unison as they wiped their tears.
"It's okay, I'm really fine." Zhang Fei softly said as he continued to hug them, and he felt really happy with their attitude.
The other women walked over to them, and Liu Hua asked curiously. "So who managed to get the Fire Yang Flower?"

"Your husband managed to get it, he managed to outwit all of us." It was Zhang Lingxue who replied with a bitter smile; actually, she was still annoyed at not being able to get the Fire Yang Flower, but there was nothing more she could do now. "Not only that, but he also managed to subdue the Divine Beast, and the snake is now his beast contract."
"Huh!?" Liu Hua and the Wen Twins were dumbfounded hearing that, and even the other women looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief and curiosity.

Zhang Fei softly laughed at their reaction, then said triumphantly. "I did manage to subdue the divine beast, but we will talk about it later, and we must return to the Chu Clan immediately, I really can't wait to swallow the Fire Yang Flower."
"En, fine then." Liu Hua nodded in agreement, and then he asked Zhang Lingxue. "What are your plans now? Are you going straight back to the Central Region?"

Zhang Lingxue shook her head. "I haven't been to the Western Region for a long time, so I will go with you to the Chu Clan first. Moreover, I still have to hunt down Wenhao, I am sure that he will not be able to return to the Central Region alone."
"Wenhao?" Liu Hua frowned at that.
Zhang Fei then took them out of Blazing Foothills Village, while Zhang Lingxue told them about Chang Wenhao's actions.
They were shocked to hear Chang Wenhao's actions, and Liu Hua reacted angrily. "You should have let me kill him sooner; a scumbag like him has no right to live."

"Sigh, forget it; I will hunt and kill him with my own hands later." Zhang Lingxue replied with a sigh, her eyes clearly showing that she was serious about it, and Chang Wenjie couldn't help but sigh in her heart.
When they arrived outside the village, Zhang Lingxue took out her flying artifact, and she invited them to go with her because her flying artifact was more superior to the Wen Twins' flying artifact.
Shortly after they left Blazing Foothills Village, two men were walking down Blazing Volcano, and their expressions looked so ugly. Then one of the men asked. "What are your plans now, Wenhao?"

"I don't know, Gu Zhan. If it wasn't for your artifact, then my master would have found and killed me by now." Chang Wenhao replied as he stared into the distance. "Perhaps I'm going to the Southern Region because my mother's family lives there."
"Alright then." Gu Zhan nodded. Although he saved Chang Wenhao when he was running away from Zhang Lingxue, he had no intention of helping him any further. "I will return to my sect right now."
